This aint my first rodeo, Peter.

I’m used to people underestimating me. _Truly!_

I didn’t become the first woman to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets by having a lot of people believe in me.

I didn’t pick myself up after dropping out of high school and go waitress at Waffle House to put food on the table because of handouts.

I didn’t become a strong conservative FIGHTER in Washington DC because I didn’t face challenges.

**_NOPE!_**

I got to where I am because I am a fighter. I’m not afraid to get dirt under my fingernails and sweat on my brow for the things that I believe in. _**And I believe in America.**_ I will fight until the day I die for what is RIGHT in this country – _and I’m not a sell-out to corporate greed like the former Speaker._

Which is why he is coming after me on his revenge tour. I can’t be bought. My vote is not for sale. I work for the American people and the American people ONLY. _Which frankly scares the HECK out of people here in Washington who aren’t used to people they cannot control._

Fellow Conservative,

Do you feel like the American Dream is slipping away?

Do you sometimes feel like you don’t recognize your country anymore... or that we’re living in an episode of the Twilight Zone?

Me too. My name is Eric Hovde, and I’m excited to announce that I am officially launching my campaign for Senate in Wisconsin.

I’m running because I have had it with business as usual in Washington. Career politicians and their radical Left-wing agendas are changing our country for the worse and robbing future generations of the American Dream.

I’ll be upfront with you. I’m NOT a career politician. I’m a proud husband, father, business owner, and fourth-generation Wisconsinite. I’m running to _RESTORE THE AMERICAN DREAM_. [**Will you join our fight?**](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=eaeeb70f71694513a1830ac4384f25ac&_e=qLp36EdLbYEuJod-xQqXjcQwavfzH1jYI6HzHkiSHW3cXb2xVkJT4l8dTxr_Bg0aKOm7tUtMtaErAMvsrJcpIxdyWuBLT0GTWFEalgOxw69KNGHX-r44X_3dd3voMagTqXHOivq7jtQWELJigohhXdESXSBwFg27gpCHbOHsvODNfm8_b_Wefx6tV4rv6hYrLBe2GSZF5Rczk1RrUsWkL0JppqPDM2teRf6Q9O0k1vy2k6zZdVn9DbiE8s7zXhSWyxSQwzLYgltINCUqa_eNIj2kgs88YmkPXuY4TzTlLoibYPAqq_lC-IA80TqiFxD1CN7vG6fXu6NavGxeqFQWa0fECg48mHX2yUFqpq4v_Dd5-h1xNIbgO4pt4IWY_Fc96EDwxi5DoxwgF1KUgbKDDg%3D%3D)

On Friday of last week, news broke that Vladimir Putin had murdered Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny. That news sent a shockwave throughout the world and prompted world leaders to respond.
Putin is a murderous dictator who loathes dissent, free speech and true democracy. Though his regime killed Navalny, they won’t be able to quash his legacy. His life and his work gave hope and voice to millions of Russians who are tired of Putin -- people who are ready to fight for change.
But since the war in Ukraine started, there has been a rapidly growing faction of the Republican Party that idolizes Putin. In fact, the Russian President appears to have a real grip on what now seems like a significant portion of MAGA Republicans. It’s strange and it’s scary, friend.
That’s why today, in the wake of this news, I’m asking you to make a contribution to Serve America -- an organization dedicated to electing a new generation of Democratic leaders to Congress. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-america] I can assure you, they believe in democracies, side with America, and know better than to idolize Vladimir Putin.
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-america?refcode=email_20220217_SA_endorsements]
In his final message to the world, Navalny reminded us that "the only thing necessary for the triumph of evil, is for good people to do nothing."
This is an election year. Trump, who leads the Republican Party and will likely be on the ballot in November, has openly fawned over Putin. He’s repeatedly shared his admiration of him and many in his party are now following his lead.
We cannot afford to do nothing. We have to fight this year and every year to elect leaders who love America and work to improve our democracy -- not break it.
Navalny had what Putin will never have: courage, true patriotism, soul.
Let’s honor him by continuing to fight.
-Seth

His life and his work gave hope and voice to millions of Russians who are tired of Putin -- people who are ready to fight for change. But since the war in Ukraine started, there has been a rapidly growing faction of the Republican Party that idolizes Putin. In fact, the Russian President appears to have a real grip on what now seems like a significant portion of MAGA Republicans. It’s strange and it’s scary, friend. | | Friend,On Sunday’s episode of _Last Week Tonight_ , John Oliver took a strong stance against the rampant corruption on the Supreme Court: He’ll offer Clarence Thomas $1 million a year to resign. Does that sound ridiculous to you?**Because Thomas’ luxurious lifestyle has been paid for by billionaires who want to keep him on the Court for decades.** Clarence Thomas has been receiving hundreds of thousands of dollars worth of gifts and trips from his conservative benefactors for years and it has gone largely unchecked...at least Oliver’s gifts to Thomas would be transparent. On the show, Oliver said that, “If we’re going to keep the bar of accountability this low, perhaps it’s time to exploit that low bar the same way billionaires have successfully done for decades” before offering the lump sum of money _and_ a luxury motor coach to get Justice Thomas to leave the Court. **[**We all deserve better than a Supreme Court that so clearly works for the ultra-wealthy and special interests rather than the American people. If you agree with John Oliver that the corruption on the Court is unacceptable and dangerous, please chip in $10 right now so we can work together to pass judicial ethics reform.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79402285/456359244/444630146?refcode=2-20-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJlNzgzZWE3LTRmZDAtZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=wq8Nt9iw0ikZQtU9Vi9ojWfTbSxp3t9TdYVSMfnJJsc=)** John Oliver was right. The rampant corruption on the Supreme Court has led to rulings wildly out of step with public opinion and caused distrust among the American people. We need to pass the _Supreme Court Ethics, Recusal, and Transparency (SCERT) Act_ as soon as possible. This way we can prevent further corruption in our Supreme Court by improving the financial disclosure process, strengthening recusal standards, and creating an enforceable code of conduct for the Court, something that, clearly, it is in desperate need of. Hello: This weekend marked the one-year anniversary when the delegates elected a new Michigan Republican Party−one that empowers the grassroots and is proudly aligned with the U.S. Constitution and Republican Party Platform. It was fitting that the State Committee convened on February 17, in Mount Pleasant for another productive day addressing party business. We heard reports from various committees, had healthy discussions−including on the topic of better political representation−and elected Dan Bonamie as our new MIGOP Co-Chair. Congratulations, Dan! I was also pleased to announce that Sabrina Pritchett-Evans is the new chairman of the Finance Committee. She steps into this position with an impressive background and extensive experience in fundraising and financial management. I want to thank Rich Pirrotta for serving as Finance chairman. We are so grateful to him for getting us started! Please join me in welcoming these patriots into their new roles in service to the party and to all Michigan Republicans. disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Well, we’re six weeks into 2024, and it’s safe to say that this year is already a bit...chaotic. While Democrats are doing our best to govern in a divided government, Republicans are doing their best to prevent any meaningful governing.
Before we get to some important updates from the House, one important note on my re-election campaign: As my team continues to remind me, keeping up with our fundraising before the next FEC filing deadline is a critical part of winning in November, so I have to prioritize it. I’m running against a MAGA extremist who recently reported raising more than half a million dollars, so I’m asking for your support to fight back. Will you contribute whatever you can to help my campaign stay on track to win? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
OK – let’s get to the latest from Washington and the House floor. Here’s what’s been going on:
- We’ll start with some good news – I was proud to introduce a new bipartisan bill that would allow new moms in Congress to vote by proxy for six weeks after giving birth. It’s so important to have more young people and parents in office, but if we want that, we need to make sure our institutions are built for them.
- We passed legislation that would expand the Child Tax Credit, lifting more than 400,000 kids out of poverty this year, and enhance the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit, helping to build more than 200,000 housing units that are affordable. We still have a lot more work to do to tackle the housing affordability crisis and build up our social safety net, but this legislation is a good start.
- It wouldn’t be a House update this year without acknowledging some challenges – which Republicans have created in spades. Extreme House Republicans (including Speaker Mike Johnson, who’s certainly in the running for most embarrassing Speaker of the House, despite stiff competition from Kevin McCarthy), declined to even consider passing much-needed foreign aid, despite Democrats and Republicans coming together in large numbers to pass the package in the Senate.
- And of course, there’s the fact that House Republicans continue to focus on politics over helping people. In the last two weeks, they’ve found time to focus on a sham impeachment of the Secretary of Homeland Security, introduce a resolution saying Donald Trump never engaged in the insurrection, introduce a resolution condemning the Biden Administration, and introduce a bill to appropriate $25 billion for a border wall. Oh, and introduce a bill to extend architectural copyright protections to golf courses.
That was a lot – I know.
Truly, thank you for your support through all of this. Whether you’re reading these emails, showing up during key moments, donating when you’re able to give, or all of the above – having you by my side makes all the difference, especially as we get closer to November.
If you’re as energized as I am to defeat extreme Republicans like my opponent, take back the House, and keep making progress for all Americans, I hope you’ll consider chipping in to support my re-election campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Despite obstruction and gridlock from the GOP, we’re still getting things done in Congress – so just imagine what we’ll be able to accomplish once we regain our majority in November!
Thank you for being here.
-Sara
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Congresswoman Sara Jacobs
California’s 51st District
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
If you can’t give much right now, I want you to know that even $1 or $5 makes a difference. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em] And if you can’t give at all, I understand. I appreciate you taking the time to read these emails and stay connected with my campaign – regardless of whether or not you’re able to chip in financially. Thank you!

Friend,

This is a once-in-a-generation election and the only opportunity in the Central Valley to gain ground for the Republican party in Congress. The future of the Central Valley is on the line!

Jim Costa’s time in politics goes back over 50 years, working on the Hill in D.C. and attending the Watergate hearing in 1973. It’s time for change and a new generation of leadership providing common-sense solutions—solutions that prioritize local needs and provides solutions to the hardships we all face.

I stand on over 20 years of professional real-world experience solving complex problems and delivering solutions since my service in the military. I am committed to building upon my background to bring common-sense solutions to Washington and deliver for our community as I represent you in Congress! Not just for my children’s future but for a golden California future for all!

Please join me at our special #TeamMaher event so we can get our message out!

Control of the Senate and the Presidency will come down to Wisconsin. This will be the #1 battleground state for Republicans and Democrats. body:
Alexandria's work opened a door to investigate Trump.
#
Almost 5 years ago, Alexandria questioned Michael Cohen — former personal attorney and ‘fixer’ for Donald Trump — in her very first committee hearing as a newly elected Congressmember.
Alexandria used her 5 minutes to grill Cohen carefully about Trump's finances. At the time, many said that her work opened the door to future investigations into Trump’s criminal dealings.
**They were right: Trump was just ordered to pay a $355 million fine for fraud damages**.
The Attorney General of New York said the years-long investigation only began because of Cohen's testimony at the hearing.1
[Since coming to Congress, Alexandria has called out corruption wherever she sees it. Will you contribute $5 to power her fight for progress and accountability in our government? Every dollar goes toward building a system that works for all of us. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240220.muk4C9&refcode=em20240220-5853-P_FND_EGR_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5853%2E2526796%2ESfsvnJ)

NY Attorney General Letitia James' investigation revealed the former President and his top advisors routinely found ways to falsely inflate Trump’s net worth to secure hundreds of millions of dollars in loans between 2008 and 2018.
In one example, Trump misrepresented the value of his Mar-a-Lago property — claiming it was worth $400-$600 million, when an appraiser valued it between $18-$27 million2 — to deceive banks into higher loans and lower interest rates.
At Friday's ruling, Trump was also barred from working any top-level position at any New York-based company, including parts of the Trump Organization, or receiving a loan from any New York bank for three years.3
**Alexandria knows that we cannot push towards social and economic justice for all without first fighting the corruption in our establishment politics.**
[That’s why Alexandria accepts no contributions from corporations or special interests — she is able to fight for a better world only with your grassroots support. **_"I hope Nancy gets the help she needs. I really do... She’s got a lot of challenges." -FORMER Speaker of the House, Kevin McCarthy_**

This aint my first rodeo, Fellow American.

I’m used to people underestimating me. _Truly!_

I didn’t become the first woman to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets by having a lot of people believe in me.

I didn’t pick myself up after dropping out of high school and go waitress at Waffle House to put food on the table because of handouts.

I didn’t become a strong conservative FIGHTER in Washington DC because I didn’t face challenges.

**_NOPE!_**

I got to where I am because I am a fighter. I’m not afraid to get dirt under my fingernails and sweat on my brow for the things that I believe in. _**And I believe in America.**_ I will fight until the day I die for what is RIGHT in this country – _and I’m not a sell-out to corporate greed like the former Speaker._

Which is why he is coming after me on his revenge tour. I can’t be bought. My vote is not for sale. I work for the American people and the American people ONLY. _Which frankly scares the HECK out of people here in Washington who aren’t used to people they cannot control._

**So, today, I’m taking the former Speaker’s advice:** [**I’m asking for help._Not from lobbyists or party leaders but from the people I work for._ Help from you, Fellow American.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=7418bbb944434388a8abce782096a7e2&_e=AR-2TYqhqEUCIbQG2hKV7oF22eE2YlyM43RRLq0PWMw6im9fbsahw5Honkgi5_pB9dJf3z-dsCLwjLDZKGB6KZv3fqYpq3SbiBIB5HiQojR0dLdy172OabFEjKSYWL9zn2grurXc4xH3lf_xZ-o_SpdMVjwHaTmFpXdrrSsqNbiy6cOOg9017zbzJbeZjTOxjdks5jZou60wznhc3gt5tvrSW_E4h7-EhZUJmIzsRByxDozCiXCCTq0YqpuBn8sj2xWt1oxmlZn_258bIdUYlAiKH1uSDJLQnuTkRYe4hnPZ0UPGWvPq_aiiGNPROBCRIwAhMRb14ccEH4ylYOC9QLJfsj2wPezkuaLnMS2h78NIVEAd_hZP_ueiIXDW0yyn)

Everyone in Washington is after me. They are throwing MILLIONS of dollars against me, but I don’t care because I know I can rely on you to help me claw my way back to Washington and keep fighting the good fight. [**Any amount you can spare today, even if it’s just sharing my story, would mean the world to me.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=7418bbb944434388a8abce782096a7e2&_e=AR-2TYqhqEUCIbQG2hKV7oF22eE2YlyM43RRLq0PWMw6im9fbsahw5Honkgi5_pB9dJf3z-dsCLwjLDZKGB6KZv3fqYpq3SbiBIB5HiQojR0dLdy172OabFEjKSYWL9zn2grurXc4xH3lf_xZ-o_SpdMVjwHaTmFpXdrrSsqNbiy6cOOg9017zbzJbeZjTOxjdks5jZou60wznhc3gt5tvrSW_E4h7-EhZUJmIzsRBxWhvmFad83KooY45fK9eQGATMZpP8EoAWWLJgwvj7Oene2-J439-WSd_YvjCGsDw94XYhOOVuVxzNo1C4MIefhVvytgXiCQQcJrWM_Qjrb1-M1lYgS2AoZO9o3DjZ5fTglKzzl83a9-NlnV-4RIi7k)

name: Your America
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30591%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xtssWTTku%2f6dXLfmH9W9%2fg&sysid=1) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College’s **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration’s weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That’s why I’m asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30592%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QDDriaBiYm3ScpJU1rvtqQ&sysid=1)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today’s ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America’s great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America’s leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we’ve seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30592%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QDDriaBiYm3ScpJU1rvtqQ&sysid=1)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Your America News

body:
Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate.

| | | This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zseve00tg0fh8ecldulie7naanjebsauee94m4s0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sli6coj2cdh2bs)

Dear Friend,

Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year, I'm reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to questions like "_Does God exist? Can we know God?_ " with my students.

These questions are at the core of what it means to be human - both in our relationship with each other and with God. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zm8ll5s989et96om96jeddsnjqaajgdnsm1ojr5g_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sli6coj2cdh2bs) Today, I want to offer you that same experience by sending you [**a limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course, "Western Heritage - From the Book of Genesis to John Locke,"**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlfrahtjdcdpgkj2acjuekiuvcsrv24e2g140of0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sli6coj2cdh2bs) as a token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of Hillsdale's efforts to educate America.

I invite you to study the history of the "big questions" with my colleagues and me.

Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link: **[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/support-western-heritage-dvd](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkcr3a3ulgrmku48thnbito2h5nllfi7uju6l24o_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sli6coj2cdh2bs)**

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: trial balloon
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Does a preborn baby the same age as the rubber model in the photo below deserve a chance at life?

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-shhqud-duchtdja-y/)

Sadly, according to _The New York Times_ at least — _the official publication of the establishment Left_ — both former President Donald Trump and President Joe Biden agree the answer is “no.”

You see, this baby model in the photo is at 15-weeks of gestation, and President Biden wants abortion up until birth.

As for Donald Trump?

According to what could be a trial balloon floated by some advisors in his campaign, the former President is rumored to privately favor a 16-week abortion ban — which would leave this child unprotected.

Pro-Life Friend, I need your help to shoot this trial balloon out of the sky NOW, _not leave it alone like it’s a Chinese spy balloon_ — before it’s too late.

If we don’t, the Abortion Lobby’s pals could cruise to victory in 2024.

****[So, can I count on you to sign your #TeachTrumpLife petition right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-shhqud-duchtdja-j/)?****

**_As you’ll see, this petition simply_ :**

**1** \- Urges President Trump not to listen to the advisors within his campaign who are scared of the abortion issue;

**2** \- States the scientific fact that human life begins at conception; and

**3** \- Insists President Trump stand strong for ALL innocent preborn life.
The fact is, keeping the pro-life movement energized and excited should be a key part of President Trump’s election strategy.

A law forbidding abortion past 16-weeks of a pregnancy, _that would only prevent 6% of abortions_ , is not going to do that.

__Even France has a 14-week law_!_

We saw what happens last year when Republicans campaign on abortion policy that’s to the left of France.

As you may remember, Virginia Governor Glenn Youngkin came out in favor of a _15-week_ law and actually ran TV ads saying “there is no ban” on abortion.

Pro-lifers in Virginia were deflated because they understood that 94% of abortions are committed before the 15-week mark.

Not only that, but once you say some abortions are ok, you dehumanize the issue and you lose the moral high ground.

After all, why is killing a baby at 14 weeks ok, **_but at 15 weeks it’s not_?**

Governor Youngkin face-planted as Democrats took over the Virginia House and kept control of the Senate.

But in races where Republicans campaigned as strong pro-lifers and where _Students for Life Action_ proudly engaged, they won!

__The lesson here should be clear_._

Sadly, it hasn’t gotten through to all of President Trump’s advisors who floated this 16-week abortion trial balloon.

I can tell you point blank, **I will not** be able to field an army of young pro-lifers to knock on doors in Battleground States if this is the position his campaign adopts.

That’s why you and I need to politely and respectfully insist President Trump do the right thing and pledge to protect all innocent life.

**_President Trump will listen to you_.**

He’s proven that time and again over the years.

But if _The New York Times’_ report is true _(which is always questionable with that news rag)_ , he’s getting some bad advice.

There is just too much at stake in 2024 for you and me to remain silent.

The answer is for politicians to just start saying the **_truth_.**

Abortion is **_wrong_** at any stage.

It’s the taking of an _**innocent life**_ at any stage.

And it should be _**illegal**_ at any stage.

**[If you agree, please sign your #TeachTrumpLife petition right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-shhqud-duchtdja-i/).**

Thank you so much for all you do!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

| Gold Dome Download February 21, 2024
Today, we wish you a very happy kickoff to the 2024 election cycle in Georgia! Early voting is now underway for the March 12th presidential primary. It will run for three weeks, now through March 8th. If you plan on voting in this election by mail, you must request your absentee ballot by March 1st. You can look up your early voting location and hours - or request an absentee ballot - by visiting [mvp.sos.ga.gov](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001MXllol3ajNq_oedUmSX_J44wds2_5AuFL2e80pGYfnz3-hkIwFTr_D1wm67zjhpj3eZ0Vs7RIee_Ck1QjhC-RZ-3olKgvEK7wYgVwhNkaOSGf_hiJSEln2g4QeThsx1Fy6NhDazahUkgCQIMh2R1lw==&c=ByaF7RACrIVIOhRiaRscM7BySOuDrw_YwBAo9Aa_U_MDsuLKAsxISQ==&ch=YRgXlPx8RNE0a0d8VCVkDBL5AGA44gWWBQfOT0Lt7NQ0yTrQBD0OxQ==).

| Georgia Sends Additional National Guard Reinforcements to the Border Last week, Governor Brian Kemp, Lt. Governor Burt Jones, and Speaker of the House Jon Burns announced the state will deploy Georgia National Guard reinforcements to the Southern Border in order to aid Texas in its Operation Lone Star mission. They will assist in the construction of a forward command post on the Texas border with Mexico.
Since Joe Biden took office, over 8.5 million illegal immigrants have crossed into our nation. But as a result of the Texas Guard's Operation Lone Star actions, over 56,000 pounds of meth, 458 million doses of fentanyl, and $51 million in currency have been seized. Senator Steve Gooch serves as the Senate Majority Leader. He represents the 51st Senate District of Georgia, including his hometown of Dahlonega. He is a member of the Appropriations, Finance, Redistricting, Regulated Industries & Utilities, Transportation, and Administrative Affairs Committees. That’s why we are taking action to expose and punish those responsible! strongly allege numerous serious violations and criminal activity, including:#1 - Maricopa County refuses to maintain the mandatory chain of custody for ballots.In 2022, these failures resulted in a discrepancy of over 25,000 votes – larger than the margin of victory in the state governor’s race#2 - Maricopa County ignores mandatory reconciliation procedures to track each ballot printed or issued to a voter. The law requires tracking and reconciling ballots cast and voters checked in to stop fraud, but the Defendants do not perform any reconciliation procedures at all#3 - Arizona law requires ballot drop boxes to be staffed by at least two election officials positioned close enough to view each person who deposits ballots into it.Maintaining an unstaffed drop box is a felony. However, Maricopa County maintains unstaffed, unsupervised ballot drop boxes, facilitating illegal ballot harvesting For many years now, the Maricopa County Board of Supervisors and the County Recorder have consistently failed to lawfully administer elections. We believe these individuals are fully aware of their election law violations.Make no mistake: Our lawsuit has been filed to prevent the November 5, 2024, election from being tainted with the same mistakes and maladministration that occurred during the 2020 and 2022 elections and to prevent election interference from occurring.Thank you for your support of our mission and historic legal actions here!~ Stephen Miller President, America First Legal | | ~ America First Legal Foundation is an IRS-approved section 501(c)(3) public charity. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.

Thomas Jefferson described them as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. # WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 21, 2024
---|---

Dear Friend,

Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year, I'm reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to questions like "_Does God exist? Can we know God?_ " with my students.

These questions are at the core of what it means to be human - both in our relationship with each other and with God. [ ](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9a5332d1d0ed40e4a4c74e4366a483ff&_e=ej36fwBQCAY1XSXsrjWbCg1X6H5bDuq6ZQNSloPBVeR876psx5HK1yxhv1dE-47tFQrJ2IWtUk4wc_jzw6UcIsdxw2SqP2PZvH6UtHxur5uH8sYtLMQ9Ket2u7oXEc2Oq4FRjT7MWTzpWWVLoh08m3U6-owZrBaqbXOsG4oBElc6oxXL_PSbqLxBTxLeQSZBBiGNZzhI5GkY5EczMEDz_GSXodYotCasfxiBazAY3NxoQUS_mAfvtYnq7YWoazs5IDCTlZZG0ZObfQmvJwJzAvEhMZemiWWyhi3b7MTEJirgPh5JMTog9JQ96aizKaSV-caNNNtY6P2s5gciLZWpFrr2aALalN5Pm8DFNuu07WVRP2-Nkexc_f_1HiswF0EiooKym8-HjFCd849tGTvl2EgAgv0EWDCV7xCLgMgl9R8%3D) Today, I want to offer you that same experience by sending you [**a limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course, "Western Heritage - From the Book of Genesis to John Locke,"**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9a5332d1d0ed40e4a4c74e4366a483ff&_e=ej36fwBQCAY1XSXsrjWbCg1X6H5bDuq6ZQNSloPBVeR876psx5HK1yxhv1dE-47tFQrJ2IWtUk4wc_jzw6UcIsdxw2SqP2PZvH6UtHxur5uH8sYtLMQ9Ket2u7oXEc2Oq4FRjT7MWTzpWWVLoh08m3U6-owZrBaqbXOsG4oBElc6oxXL_PSbqLxBTxLeQSZBBiGNZzhI5GkY5EczMEDz_GSXodYotCasfxiBazAY3NxoQUS_mAfvtYnq7YWoazs5IDCTlZZG0ZObfQmvJwJzAnIh-1VUNMWG_rqGfCWasnVFmg82iiViJJkCBt3tfYEpNL9FDKAJ7-M97F34ims9IlzaunOUTw2wRH_0uHIkGJfzJAqn5gJmyxZc8ylOQo9m29H45zrfeH6ld8-t9qJWlV9j666U9mxi4kkSbdn1bZQ%3D) as a token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of Hillsdale's efforts to educate America.

I invite you to study the history of the "big questions" with my colleagues and me.

Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link: **[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/support-western-heritage-dvd](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9a5332d1d0ed40e4a4c74e4366a483ff&_e=ej36fwBQCAY1XSXsrjWbCg1X6H5bDuq6ZQNSloPBVeR876psx5HK1yxhv1dE-47tFQrJ2IWtUk4wc_jzw6UcIsdxw2SqP2PZvH6UtHxur5uH8sYtLMQ9Ket2u7oXEc2Oq4FRjT7MWTzpWWVLoh08m3U6-owZrBaqbXOsG4oBElc6oxXL_PSbqLxBTxLeQSZBBiGNZzhI5GkY5EczMEDz_GSXodYotCasfxiBazAY3NxoQUS_mAfvtYnq7YWoazs5IDCTlZZG0ZObfQmvJwJzAvuGZWTLjJnyHXVFCbdwy6DVOzL0jf-5e_l6m9Dkl9S_Tiwcqs590kWP4aXaNDQk2Bqt7t4oSYrMfG80HDr-IhOc0IVQJRxU1xglwFwcEMx34_HSXKblEZYFX1n2gKu-RGz2_bOKwhNAqqLOSQ9ZG0k%3D)**

| Peter, **A new episode of Common Ground with Bill Spadea has just gone live!** Join Bill as he dives deep into the heart of the issues that matter most to us as Americans and as staunch defenders of common sense. Joining the podcast are some of the most fearless and outspoken warriors in the battle for our liberties: Congressman Jeff Van Drew, Dr. Craig Wax, Dr. Joel Wallskog, and Attorney Ron Berutti.
---
| | [CLICK HERE TO ACCESS THE PODCAST NOW](https://xtz223.keap-link006.com/v2/click/b6f8d909c05922c905b572f9f9334c99/eJyNj00LgkAURf_LW0vmR1HuQkREcxG1jkkfNDSOw_iUTPzvjRWuCtq-e-553AEIJZOUlBDAnR6u64EFGguuOEoKa0mseKXuync8xwLB5S3WdasgGL6WZ2A6O1tvaQH1Cg1yPOzCNMnjc5bkqSEV0-bHf57N2p890X6XZDCOP8VYcYo6424gIN3itKjkZhWdtDD8lUgFtn3hQjSKlcgWRV3ZgndoykwplOVneYr9WzE-AYLQYQM=)
---
| Bill and his guests tackle our nation's most critical issues head-on:
* The Invasion of Illegal Immigrants: A deep dive on the dangers of our open border and the untold stories that mainstream media chooses to ignore.
* Vaccine Mandates & Their Effects: Get the real scoop on how these mandates are impacting our communities, our health, and our freedoms.
* The Fight Against Mask Mandates: Learn about the legal battles being waged to protect our rights and the future of our nation.

**Bill is not just discussing the problems; he's highlighting the solutions and ways you can join the fight.** [**Tune in to this week's podcast**](https://xtz223.keap-link006.com/v2/click/11acd5e0dcc902f4aeaf4bce1b0d109d/eJyNj00LgkAURf_LW0viR1HuREREcxG1jkkfNDSOw_iUTPzvjRW1KWj77rnncUcglExSWkEAV7q5rgcWaCy54igpaiSx8pG6S9_xHAsEl5dEN52CYPxafgPz2dl4vgU0KDTIfhdGWVokxzwtMkMqps2P_zzr1ccTb8M0h2n6KcaaU9wbdwsB6Q7nRRU3q-igheHPRCqw7RMXolWsQrYom9oWvEdTZkqhrF7LMxyeiukOhexhBw==) and arm yourself with the knowledge and insight to stand up against overreach and tyranny. The battle for our freedoms is being fought on many fronts, and it's crucial that we stay informed, engaged, and ready to act. Until Next Time, Common Sense Action Team
---
|
---
| It’s time for Common Sense ideas and policies to dominate the landscape instead of the vicious and totally counter-productive partisan attacks that only serve to embolden the elite power brokers.You’re a part of the Common Sense Club because you know that we need RESULTS from our government, NOT RHETORIC. Many arrogant, elitist elected officials crushed our way of life during the misguided, unnecessary and deadly lockdowns. Now it’s time to hold them accountable for their actions, ignorance and negligence. The tide is turning, and today is only STEP ONE!

This year’s elections provide a can’t-miss opportunity to support small businesses and families with fiscally responsible policies, restore an education system that puts students and parents over the radical agenda of the NJEA elites, and protect and preserve our civil, economic, and medical liberty.
We believe that our government should serve the people and provide the expected services that we’re paying for! It’s time for government to function as a public service, not a propaganda tool for radicals.
We believe in REDUCING tax burdens on working families AND empowering the skilled trades and small businesses.
We believe our schools should reject Critical Race Theory and the sexualized curricula. It’s time to empower parents and stop the NJEA once and for all.
I hope you’ll join me TODAY as we discuss the results of this year’s critical elections.
If you want to stand with me against the out-of-touch career politicians who are taking New Jersey down the wrong path and help restore Common Sense, you’re in the right place!Please join me during my show tonight, call in to share your thoughts, and watch the results of this year’s elections live as they come in!
Together, we can keep working to restore Common Sense and save New Jersey and America.
Thank you,Bill Spadea
---
| [Unsubscribe](https://xtz223.infusionsoft.com/app/optOut/0/4fd6eb57577aacb0/17432692/0504b56cd2ed22cc) Common Sense Club 165 Route 35 Red Bank, New Jersey 07701 United States
---

Early voting is going on right now. Initial voter feedback from the polls is very encouraging, however, we must build on this momentum! Vote for Christian Castelli early before March 2 and make sure your voice is heard.

Primary Election Day is March 5. Encourage your neighbors, friends, works colleagues all to go out and vote for Christian Castelli.

Christian Castelli is the right man at the right time.

Christian Castelli will:
* Secure our Border
* Eliminate Inflation and Bidenomics
* Defend Freedom and the Constitution

Support a selfless leader and America First patriot.

Rep. Ryan Zinke

name: Andrew Piantidosi
subject: Honoring President Washington’s Vision
body:
Washington was a reluctant civil servant, he was a private man, he was a family man. I am many of these things – least amongst them an American Hero like our First President.
| | | |
---
| |
---
| |
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| Tomorrow marks the 292nd birth date of our first President, George Washington. I have learned much from his life, his accomplishments, his victories, and his defeats - which were in many respects, unprecedented in Western History.
George Washington took control of The Continental Army in 1775 although he had little experience commanding large, conventional armies. Much like many of us who want to make a difference in our communities, Washington heeded the call to service. Washington was a reluctant civil servant, he was a private man, he was a family man. I am many of these things - least amongst them an American Hero like our First President. Think long and hard about what public service looks like today. I for one have no interest in making this my life's endeavor, my goal is to serve the people - as best I can over the coming years. As your Congressman, restoring representation to CD-1 would be the honor of my life.
---

body:
With control of the Senate coming down to just a handful of seats, Arizona is going to be a key pickup. The only way we’ll hold power there is by defeating Kari Lake.
#

Peter, as you read this message we are getting absolutely clobbered out in Arizona.
Have you seen the polls?
Every one that’s been released over the last few months has shown Ruben trailing behind Kari Lake. Anywhere from one to six points.
She’s attacking Ruben day in, day out. Nonstop, around the clock, and now with the official backing of the National Republican Senatorial Committee.
With control of the Senate coming down to just a handful of seats, Arizona is going to be a key pickup. The only way we’ll hold power there is by defeating Kari Lake.
But even after all of that, a ton of key groups and important figures are still on the fence. They’re watching the polls, looking at our numbers, maybe even waiting for Sinema’s decision. We need their help, but they’re not in the game yet.
We’ve got to get them on our side — and the easiest way to do that is by hitting our fundraising goals.

Statement: ‘Congress Needs to Get Back to Work, Pass a Budget’ | | | | | [](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=7f147e9fe0&e=26f66c7cbd)
---
**Hudson: ‘Congress Needs to Get Back to Work, Pass a Budget’****—GOP Challenger Says Scholten & Colleagues Should ‘Stop Bickering, Start Budgeting’**
**Grand Rapids, MI** — “It’s a disservice to West Michigan that Representative Scholten and her colleagues went on vacation again right before yet another looming government shutdown,” observed Paul Hudson, the GOP candidate running against Scholten in Michigan’s Third Congressional District. Stopgap funding expires March 1 for agencies covered under spending bills for Energy, HUD, Transportation, VA and related agencies. A second deadline of March 8 applies to other agencies. [[1](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=6818fdd743&e=26f66c7cbd)] Congress has completed appropriations before the start of the fiscal year only four times in the last four decades. The last time Congress completed all bills on time was 20 years ago, in 1996. [[2](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=85feef5f64&e=26f66c7cbd)} “This is no way to run a government. If Hillary is wondering why Congress has a 15% approval rating, this is why,” observed Hudson, a West Michigan resident. [[3](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=9b08a3e68a&e=26f66c7cbd)] “There’s plenty of blame to go around, on both sides of the aisle. Nobody cares. Just get back to work until the job is done.”
“Members don’t need or deserve a holiday given their history of fiscal mismanagement. Congresswoman Scholten should go back to Washington, stop the bickering and start budgeting. Enough kicking the can down the road. Job #1 in Congress is passing a federal budget – which means prioritizing national spending – and Hillary and her colleagues have failed miserably at this most basic responsibility.”
The House plans to return on February 28. The Senate plans to return from its recess February 26.
While Congress can act within a matter of days to pass temporary spending, that short time frame raises the odds that the agencies affected by the first deadline will face a partial shutdown of at least several days. [[4](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=e7cebed084&e=26f66c7cbd)] The Republican challenger said that “from now until election day, I will continue to put forward specific measures to bring ‘budget sanity’ to Congress—it’s the bare minimum West Michigan residents deserve in their next representative.” A lifelong Michigander, Paul Hudson is seeking the Republican nomination for Congress in the state’s Third district. The [GOP primary election](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=e7c1faccd9&e=26f66c7cbd) for United States House of Representatives is Tuesday, August 6, 2024.

So - believe me when I tell you that Washington Elites have failed at protecting most Americans.... ... and career politicians are focused on big dollar donors, focused on pleasing their friends, and pushing their own swampy agendas. They 've never cared about taxing your small businesses, protecting your rights, or preventing the crises facing middle America. This is why I knew I had to run for office. I was determined to stand up to this record of failure and fight for working Americans. I'm looking out for the Americans like the ones I grew up with, the ones left behind by those who promised to look out for them. So, yes, It's the honor of a lifetime to serve this great country and the Buckeye State, but I can't keep doing it without your support. I need you. Please help. - JD Vance | - Conservative Outsider. That’s **nine****days** to raise the funds that will help: 📣 Amplify our messaging

..._and so much more._ 2024 is the 'Year of the States,' and we can't afford to fall short. Friend, my family has been built on the backs of generations of strong women. Will you let me tell you a bit about my family and how they've inspired me to run for the Senate?
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79420860/456422453/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk830-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODk0YWRkMTYtYzdkMC1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=bezDmtLn2RPYsLEpfJcEBhPkjClj7uteGxAZKOwTvYM=)
My mother worked full-time to raise my older sisters and me. That was pretty uncommon in Ecuador back then. With my mom so busy (and never much of a cook anyways), my grandmother was the one who would come over and prepare meals for us. She was an amazing cook, and she was an even stronger woman.
I remember watching her cook some of the best meals I’ve ever had — and always being there when my sisters and I needed her. Her strength and her resilience have been passed down, from generation to generation.
When I was 14, my mother made the difficult but incredibly brave decision to bring my sisters and me to America. She worked so hard in those early days. I remember her taking on double shifts at work and somehow still fitting in English classes at night. All of us kids stepped up to help make ends meet and build a home in our new country. My older sisters were always there for me, too. When school got hard, when bullies made fun of my accent, or when teachers underestimated me because of my background, they always stood up for me — and taught me to stand up for myself.
**My grandmother, my mother, and my sisters taught me to work hard and never, ever give up.** Their sacrifices and courage are the reason why I was able to go to college, start a career giving back to my community, and eventually become the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress.
They are the reason I was able to achieve my American Dream. **And now, I'm raising my daughters to live the same way — to follow their dreams and always stand up for themselves. But these days, the American Dream is out of reach for more and more families.** It's harder to get a good-paying job or afford a home. And our fundamental rights — to vote, to access health care, and so much more — are increasingly under attack.
That's why I'm running for Senate: **To give every family, here in Florida and across the country, the opportunities that mine had._And to help make it a bit easier for the next generation to achieve their American Dream._**
Look, polling data shows that my race is a statistical tie. But more than the numbers, I feel it in my bones that Florida is ready to flip blue. Families here are ready for a Senator who will listen to them and deliver results, not pull our communities apart. **[So please, if you believe in a future where we all can achieve our American Dream, will you donate $5 or whatever you can spare to help me flip Florida blue and fight for your family in the Senate? body:
( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=1438188.686.1.205c4e1e623c897c476fc48bab73f4ae )

Friend,

I have breaking news to share with you...

We at America First Legal have just filed an \*\*absolutely momentous\*\* lawsuit in Maricopa County, Arizona against their elections officials for repeatedly and egregiously violating the State of Arizona’s election administration laws.

The election interference and systematic election law violations we allege in Arizona are appalling, bone-chilling, and have the most serious consequences for every American. We all know what’s going on.

_That’s why we are taking action to expose and punish those responsible!_

_ \*\*DONATE NOW TO SUPPORT OUR EFFORTS >>\*\* _ ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=1438188.687.1.33c1ae318d65bc0e9a7daf94978c023e )

\*\*We strongly allege numerous serious violations and criminal activity, including:\*\*

\*\*#1 -\*\* _Maricopa County refuses to maintain the mandatory chain of custody for ballots. \*\*In 2022, these failures resulted in a discrepancy of over 25,000 votes – larger than the margin of victory in the state governor’s race\*\* _

\*\*#2 -\*\* _ \*\*Maricopa County ignores mandatory reconciliation procedures to track each ballot printed or issued to a voter.\*\* The law requires tracking and reconciling ballots cast and voters checked in to stop fraud, but the Defendants do not perform any reconciliation procedures at all_

\*\*#3 -\*\* _Arizona law requires ballot drop boxes to be staffed by at least two election officials positioned close enough to view each person who deposits ballots into it. \*\*Maintaining an unstaffed drop box is a felony. However, Maricopa County maintains unstaffed, unsupervised ballot drop boxes, facilitating illegal ballot harvesting\*\* _

For many years now, the Maricopa County Board of Supervisors and the County Recorder have consistently failed to lawfully administer elections. We believe these individuals are fully aware of their election law violations.

\*\*Make no mistake:\*\* Our lawsuit has been filed to prevent the November 5, 2024, election from being tainted with the same mistakes and maladministration that occurred during the 2020 and 2022 elections and to prevent election interference from occurring.

_Thank you for your support of our mission and historic legal actions here!_

\*\*PLEASE RUSH SUPPORT HERE >>\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=1438188.688.1.ec50b14f5eb69365a9277b066b1c0dd4 ) \*\* \*\*

And he’s already implied that there’s more to come. In an interview, Pensler said he’ll spend “what’s needed” to win Michigan’s open Senate seat. Here’s the thing about mega-wealthy self-funders—they can give their campaigns a million here and a million there, at the drop of a hat.
But our campaign doesn’t work that way (and honestly, can’t!) Hello Friend,

Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

body:
Republicans rigged the state. But democracy is back. |
---
The long, dark night of ultra-partisan gerrymandering is over, and a new day for democracy now dawns in the Badger State.

**On Monday morning, a new set of state legislative maps were signed into law for Wisconsin.** These maps are graded “A” for fairness by the head of the nonpartisan Princeton Gerrymandering Project. The current maps scored an F.

With the stroke of a pen, Wisconsin went from a “democracy desert” to, well, a democracy. This was all possible because of you.

[I’m going to ask you to split a $15 donation between the Democratic Party of Wisconsin and Defeat Republicans,](https://click.everyaction.com/k/79431544/456451425/1395668181?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240221_1_2&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjJkNmE3YWJhLWQwZDAtZWUxMS04NWY5LTAwMjI0ODIyMzc5NCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=uT-FlsLkvJpGfOMAvT94SbL-x2lpXdCxQm8XTpqyFxg=) but I want to tell you how we got here:

Wisconsin’s gerrymandering crisis began in 2011, when Republican lawmakers drew legislative lines that guaranteed even landslide election losses wouldn’t cost them their majorities. The result was one of the most egregious, extreme partisan gerrymanders in American political history.

In 2012 and 2018, Wisconsin voters overwhelmingly voted for Democratic majorities in the legislature but Republicans won huge majorities of the seats. In 2020 and 2022, Democrats won major statewide victories, but Republicans won near-supermajorities.

All the while, Republican politicians in Wisconsin have used their power to restrict access to the ballot, remove authorities that voters had entrusted to statewide elected officials like the Governor and Attorney General, and smash the freedoms of workers to organize and advocate for themselves.

_For thirteen years, the democracy-proof legislature has been laying siege to democracy itself._

But those statewide victories added up. In 2018, 2020, and 2023, voters built a new progressive majority on the State Supreme Court. By electing Governor Evers and preventing GOP supermajorities, they stopped hard-right maps from being signed into law. And last year, a civic uprising prevented Republicans from impeaching Janet Protasiewicz. In December, the Supreme Court ruled that Wisconsin’s legislative maps were unconstitutional.

This wasn’t easy. This team had to knock on doors, call phones, chip in, share our views with friends and online—year after year, election after election, never giving up even when it felt like all was lost.

_But we did it._

**Today, the work doesn’t end. The candidate recruitment process now goes into overdrive. And at the same time, we remain vigilant in case Republican politicians in Madison and their allies once again, through the courts or any other strategy, attempt to thwart majority rule.**

Today, we commit to doing the work, ending the malign speakership of Robin Vos, breaking the GOP supermajority in the State Senate, and paving the way towards a Democratic state Senate majority in 2026.

I’d be remiss if I didn’t ask. The number of competitive legislative seats will triple so we’ll need triple the support, Peter. **As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle.** Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. clean_body: Do you have time this morning to answer a few questions regarding what makes a good political candidate for me and my team? | | Fellow Conservative, As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams. My name is Tim Sheehy, Republican candidate for U.S. Senate from Montana. You probably don't know me, or if you do, likely from emails like this one. I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority. . In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. Chuck Schumer and Washington Democrats know that I pose a direct threat to their chances of holding on to power, and they'll do anything to stop me from winning this race - and spend $100M plus in the process. Fellow Conservative, I am under no illusions that you will support my campaign the first time you hear from me. But my life experiences have taught me that anything worth having requires working tirelessly, breaking down walls, and moving mountains to get it. I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read. In the Navy, finding yourself between a rock and a hard place is easy. This rings especially true for the individuals who have earned the honor of serving in the elite task force that is the Navy SEALs, a group of highly trained combat warriors – a brotherhood – in which I earned a spot following my graduation from the United States Naval Academy at Annapolis. Being a SEAL isn’t a one-man job; it takes teamwork, problem-solving, and coming to a consensus. When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit and recognize you’re only as strong as the weakest among you. I’ve deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific during my time as a SEAL, and I have been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces and survived to tell the tales. And believe me, there are some tales. I’ve seen the world’s dangers and stood up for freedom in the face of terrorism. I know the strength it takes to stand up and fight for what is right – which is why Our homeland is in danger. Radical Democrats in Washington want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. This FAR-LEFT liberal agenda is assaulting our society, communities, and the American Dream. The Democrats’ grip on power is seriously undermining our freedom, prosperity, and security. The only way to flip the Senate next year is to nominate a strong conservative candidate who can defeat my liberal Democrat opponent in 2024. Over the days and weeks ahead, you’ll receive emails from me and my team as we build our campaign. While I don’t want you to feel obligated to interact with each piece of content you receive in your inbox, I kindly ask you to refrain from unsubscribing from our contact list. Friend,
---
When the Packers and Bears play each other, their fans disagree on who they want to win the game. But they both agree that the referees should be neutral.
---
The same goes for our election administration.
---
In 2020, millions of private dollars were used to administer our elections.
---
Many of these funds were used for voter registration events and get-out-the-vote efforts in Democrat-leaning cities and counties. This created distrust in our election administration.
---
We cannot allow this to happen again.
---
That’s why I introduced the American Confidence in Elections Act, which will **END the use of Zuckerbucks in our election administration.**
---
Elections are partisan, but election administration should never be partisan.
---
Can I count on your support as I push to ban private election funding and secure our elections?

| | Peter,

Today, we commemorate the birthday of the late Congressman John Lewis, a monumental figure in the civil rights movement whose legacy continues to inspire us today.

We honor him not only for his work and his sacrifices during the civil rights movement, but also his fight for justice and equality in this country throughout his lifetime.

But right now, we’re witnessing unprecedented attacks on the voting rights of all Americans. The Voting Rights Act, a landmark piece of legislation, is under relentless attack, and widespread voter suppression tactics are being employed to strip the right to vote from our vulnerable communities.

[Peter, sign on now if you agree: We must continue to fight every day to enshrine voting rights, restore the full protections of the _Voting Rights Act_ , and empower our communities. ](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnnrptR6QpxzhTtclB_gMJBtO0dxGL77Ga8jd-kJqgulUbVVfPNAdpKMClw52UXJOH1b3LP3bRoNagHZhBh8JYDJjwcDy75opHb3l8XuKOHlF4VupA0KmDIV2HhnCB-WZXDLFyuqmDSoy5CdJPuNlzJ7K6Qm6SdVM5bi31hI7eteVtFgCUgupdykHBPVrVIf2hrVAKcZ-Wt0ECRzTd8EkWmjY_2VMxDFVtobjpRINmeX-A1RJBW7SHcWGgX30WhyzoXjAtFz2WO8vFKEN6pd5Fyhe8_br4j5xjzASbtSIA0diDnrEmyQuZEjCyQglZcK3c_5NazUOMX2ZnJG5FWJ0lK9/441/3j0-nPSuTQSqV_ypu-ayRA/h1/d69NLRVTCCbbGEK-cpZMZZt-H9n6xdi8tQPiZRW42YE) | | [SIGN ON](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnnrptR6QpxzhTtclB_gMJBtO0dxGL77Ga8jd-kJqgulUbVVfPNAdpKMClw52UXJOH1b3LP3bRoNagHZhBh8JYDJjwcDy75opHb3l8XuKOHlF4VupA0KmDIV2HhnCB-WZXDLFyuqmDSoy5CdJPuNlzJ7BaHLY6PblL_M9SEIgxaTMJuPo_p_f7ns6ZtgfFs2XRyuSg7nZ6S7bk3jlR7CSxbCgzaRzLX6U4qmW5JxiCqlizJH--1ooOhZyokKyOkIXthnnzZEf38_nAyKpsjnDtLhhjuTWxVbc2qpjPk0140Q6uajtPW_JDbxRju7wDHGc5tVyf_D7-q4QEh3jBhl6fmy/441/3j0-nPSuTQSqV_ypu-ayRA/h2/j1X43uOz3LYZDWgr5S-M-Wh3g-Zb44n78wt5nxHn2mA)

| | _**Taylor Swift and the Devil**_ By Sean Feucht
---
| | We are engaged in spiritual warfare, locked in battle with both the physical and spiritual realms. Almost one year ago, I wrote an op-ed in hopes of bringing awareness to the spiritual battles, both seen and unseen, being waged all around us. Last year, in my op-ed, "We are Fighting a Spiritual Battle – It’s Time We Start Acting Like We’re At War", I wrote, "The Grammy's incident is just the latest public demonic attack. Last year, we saw the Balenciaga ad campaign sexualize children. There is an ongoing agenda to confuse children into mutilating their bodies in the name of trans-ideology. The Satanic Temple even filed a lawsuit in support of religious freedom by claiming that abortion is a 'Satanic ritual.' Last night’s State of the Union highlighted just how much abortion is championed when the President proclaimed, 'Make no mistake about it: If Congress passes a national abortion ban, I will veto it,' as multiple Democrat legislators wore loathsome abortion pins." | | RITE’s goal for 2024 is for American election law to be enforced as written, not according to the partisan agendas of activist-lawyers or unelected-bureaucrats. We identified 36 court cases in 2023 that bolstered the integrity of the ballot box and have plans to be in court defending elections right up until voting is complete.

**The Latest from RITE **

**OHIO: Court Confirms Constitutionality of Election Integrity Reforms **

A federal court in Ohio has upheld the constitutionality of Ohio's election integrity reforms, mandating photo ID, drop box security, and rules for accurate tallies against baseless assault by Marc Elias. RITE defended the law alongside the NRSC and the state. The court found that there was no evidence at all that these rules burdened even a single Ohio voter and further agreed that they promoted Ohio’s interests in operating elections in which voters can have unquestioned confidence. Just over a year ago, Elias & Co. were boasting about how their lawsuit would surely stop Ohio from implementing these commonsense reforms. Now, with a Clinton judge having told the world they had wasted everyone’s time, they have let the case expire without even trying to appeal. ([Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=03c2251f41&e=ea91f782ea))

**NEW YORK: RITE Joins Stefanik's Legal Appeal in New York Early Voting Case**

A legal challenge supported by RITE and brought by U.S. Rep. Elise Stefanik against Governor Kathy Hochul is now before the state’s intermediate appellate court. The lawsuit challenges the validity of New York’s unconstitutional early mail-in voting law. New York voters told their lawmakers they did not want no-excuse absentee balloting in 2021, when they decisively rejected a constitutional amendment to authorize it. Their legislators gave it to them anyway in 2023. That’s how democracy works, right? The appellate court now has the opportunity to correct a serious threat to democracy, by confirming that in New York, the people and not the legislature have the power to authorize voting away from the polling place. Read RITE's latest court fling here. ([Visit Case Page](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=78e13cc8e2&e=ea91f782ea))

**MARYLAND: Unlawful Regulation Prevents Citizens from Verifying Accuracy of Voter Files **

Two Maryland citizens are suing the Maryland State Board of Elections (SBE) over its efforts to evade a sunshine law that helps ensure only eligible voters participate in elections. The SBE decided it would withhold public records from citizens who want to investigate registration and voting irregularities. The SBE, however, has no authority under either state or federal law to restrict the use of its public records, particularly if they are used to enhance elections. SBE is trying to evade scrutiny of its lackluster record administering elections in Maryland. RITE is supporting plaintiffs working to hold public officials accountable and ensure they are doing what needs to be done to run free and fair elections. ([Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=5ad31c869e&e=ea91f782ea))

**DAILY CALLER:** RITE’s Junior Counsels, Marshal Trigg and Riley Compton, are regularly contributing to the Daily Caller News Foundation's “Big Tent Ideas” opinion section. Read their most recent columns below.

body:
It's go time. I need everyone's help.

Hey Team Max!

We have two weeks until ELECTION DAY on March 5th! We are in the final push. Votes are already being cast.

It's go time. I need EVERYONE's help. Here are three ways to help this week:
1. Make phone calls at our campaign HQ at 4600 Campus Drive in Newport Beach. If you can drop by for at least two hours, that would be awesome, but we need as MUCH TIME AS YOU CAN VOLUNTEER. We'll have snacks and drinks for you. Could you come in to make phone calls anytime between 12 pm to 7 pm?
2. Door-to-door canvassing! Drop by the office, grab some literature, and we will tell you what neighborhood we need walkers in. This is the most impactful way to win over voters. Can you volunteer to walk anytime between 10 am and 5 pm?
3. We plan to flood OC with Max volunteers this Saturday – aiming for 100! Come to the campaign headquarters on Saturday from 9:00 am to 9:30 AM (bring a friend), and we'll put you to work. Would love to see you there - click here to RSVP! (https://www.maxforoc.com/event-details/max-volunteers-to-flood-orange-county?utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=b6075d97f9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_21_08_10&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-b6075d97f9-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Richard and the team will send updates during the week! Let's turn our district red again and WIN this primary! Thank you to ALL!

RSVP (https://www.maxforoc.com/event-details/max-volunteers-to-flood-orange-county?utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=b6075d97f9-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_21_08_10&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-b6075d97f9-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) here for Saturday! We have 13 days left! Let's do this!

- Max

| | Peter — Yesterday, I wrote to you to share that I've made the difficult decision to suspend my campaign for Congress. I'm incredibly thankful for the thousands of Oregonians I've had the privilege to meet during this journey. Despite this year's setback, my dedication to our state is stronger than ever — **and part of that is doing everything I can to ensure that the impactful candidates on the ballot this year get the support they need to succeed.** Today, I want to talk to you about another candidate (_yes_ , a former opponent) in the race for Oregon's Fifth Congressional District. I entered this race as the first Democrat because I was alarmed by the MAGA extremism of Lori Chavez-DeRemer and the Republican House Majority. Oregon's 5th District is pivotal to restoring sensible leadership to Washington, DC. **Right now, I believe that State Rep. Janelle Bynum is the most qualified candidate to achieve the task at hand: taking this seat back from Lori Chavez-DeRemer.** Today, she has my wholehearted endorsement and support, and I urge fellow 5th District Democrats to rally behind her. I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to the more than 1500 individuals who supported our campaign and contributed to safeguarding our democracy. clean_body: My dedication to Oregon includes supporting candidates who can make a difference — including former opponents. | | | | Peter — Yesterday, I wrote to you to share that I've made the difficult decision to suspend my campaign for Congress. I'm incredibly thankful for the thousands of Oregonians I've had the privilege to meet during this journey. Despite this year's setback, my dedication to our state is stronger than ever — and part of that is doing everything I can to ensure that the impactful candidates on the ballot this year get the support they need to succeed. Today, I want to talk to you about another candidate (yes , a former opponent) in the race for Oregon's Fifth Congressional District. I entered this race as the first Democrat because I was alarmed by the MAGA extremism of Lori Chavez-DeRemer and the Republican House Majority. Oregon's 5th District is pivotal to restoring sensible leadership to Washington, DC. Right now, I believe that State Rep. Janelle Bynum is the most qualified candidate to achieve the task at hand: taking this seat back from Lori Chavez-DeRemer. Today, she has my wholehearted endorsement and support, and I urge fellow 5th District Democrats to rally behind her. I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to the more than 1500 individuals who supported our campaign and contributed to safeguarding our democracy. | | **I am excited to share with you that our campaign has received the first endorsement of the 2024 cycle — and as the son of a union power line worker, I am honored to receive the endorsement of the Communications Workers of America's Pacific Northwest Labor Council.** I grew up in a union household and know firsthand the benefits of union membership. Our family had health insurance. My father earned a decent wage, and his union negotiated cost-of-living wage increases. He saved money for retirement, so he and my mother did not have to worry about their aging years. And, all of us kids had the opportunity to go to college. **In short, my father's union membership afforded him the dignity that all workers deserve.** Growing up in a union household is why I stand steadfastly with unions today. Decades of corporate assaults on unions has led to declining union membership. This assault on unions is, quite simply, an assault on American workers. It is no coincidence that declining union membership has gutted the middle class. In Congress, I am working to restore our unions and stem the tide of economic disparity. **[Will you make a contribution of $16 today and help me continue to bring the policies that help uplift working families to the floor of Congress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79445520/456488069/1596212816?refcode=2024-02-20-cwa&recurring=&amount=16&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=c3a5de6a-dfd0-ee11-85f9-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjM2E1ZGU2YS1kZmQwLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=I0xkWdRWD-iqKdhK4oqtmcfohFaQ0h6bE1rtSXueqeI=)** [Donate Now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79445521/456488070/1596212816?refcode=2024-02-20-cwa&recurring=&amount=16&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=c3a5de6a-dfd0-ee11-85f9-002248223794&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjM2E1ZGU2YS1kZmQwLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=I0xkWdRWD-iqKdhK4oqtmcfohFaQ0h6bE1rtSXueqeI=) Our economy favors those at the top – at the expense of workers everywhere. clean_body: Honored to receive the endorsement of the Communications Workers of America’s Pacific Northwest Labor Council. | | | | I am excited to share with you that our campaign has received the first endorsement of the 2024 cycle — and as the son of a union power line worker, I am honored to receive the endorsement of the Communications Workers of America's Pacific Northwest Labor Council. I grew up in a union household and know firsthand the benefits of union membership. Our family had health insurance. My father earned a decent wage, and his union negotiated cost-of-living wage increases. He saved money for retirement, so he and my mother did not have to worry about their aging years. And, all of us kids had the opportunity to go to college. In short, my father's union membership afforded him the dignity that all workers deserve. Growing up in a union household is why I stand steadfastly with unions today. Decades of corporate assaults on unions has led to declining union membership. This assault on unions is, quite simply, an assault on American workers. It is no coincidence that declining union membership has gutted the middle class. In Congress, I am working to restore our unions and stem the tide of economic disparity. = = Our economy favors those at the top – at the expense of workers everywhere. Americans today save less because wages do not keep pace with the costs of housing, food, and gas. Medical debt and student loan debt have decimated an entire generation's economic prospects. We cannot continue down this path, and I am determined to help pave a better way forward for future generations.
