Friend, I'll never forget what it felt like to finally become an American citizen.
I came to America as a 14-year-old. Moving to a new country and trying to make ends meet wasn't easy. But this country gave my family the chance to dream of a future full of opportunities that we could not have had in Ecuador.
So when I had the chance to become a citizen, I took it. I studied hard to pass the exam, memorizing branches of government, founding fathers, and articles of the Constitution. My naturalization ceremony was held in a huge room with hundreds and hundreds of new Americans. American flags were _everywhere_. I remember proudly singing the national anthem and saying the Pledge of Allegiance as the weight of the moment began to sink in.
If you were born an American, I don't think it's possible to fully understand exactly what becoming a citizen means — the sense of relief after spending so many years fighting for and dreaming of this moment.**Knowing that you've finally made it. This is truly your home now. You're here. You've done it. And more than anything else,_you're safe._**
Your freedoms and rights are guaranteed. Your government will protect you. You have the right to choose your leaders. And you can count on the peaceful transition of power.
**I knew in that moment, as I proudly said the Pledge of Allegiance, that I had a sacred responsibility to protect my new country and make sure that families here could count on this all-too-rare sense of safety for generations to come.** I vowed to vote, to be involved in my community, to give back, and to make a difference however I could.
That journey led me all the way to Congress, where I had the privilege of speaking at naturalization ceremonies like the one I had attended decades ago. But in the years since I became a citizen, I've watched extremists threaten that precious safety. They've spread conspiracies about our elections, blocked commonsense gun safety reforms, and incited a deadly insurrection that ended the peaceful transition of power.
**_That’s why I’m running for Senate. To save the promise of the American Dream — prosperity, freedom, and safety._**
With experts saying Rick Scott is one of the most vulnerable Senators up for reelection in 2024, I know that we can defeat him and restore the promise of America — but not without all hands on deck. **[So please, will you join the fight for a better, safer future by donating $5 to my campaign? _**5 steps toward a fresh approach to health care reform**_ By Bobby Jindal and Newt Gingrich _These 5 fresh principles for health care reform will resonate across party lines_
---
As the cost of living continues to be a crucial concern for voters, there’s an urgent need for candidates to present viable solutions for making health care both affordable and accessible. Here are five fresh principles for health care reform that can resonate across party lines.

**Address root causes, not just symptoms.** One of the biggest reasons major Washington-led health care reforms have failed to lower health care costs is because they focus on health insurance instead of health care, and very little on health itself.

ObamaCare and the Inflation Reduction Act are perfect examples. Every year, these programs give more money to health insurance companies to offset the costs of higher premiums for people with larger incomes. A better approach is to fund American patients, not health insurance companies, by giving them direct control over the subsidy they qualify for and let them use it to buy the care and coverage that works best for them. **[](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=8e271653affb4e60a4b697b772a3d9a1&_e=SuNI24LDKEUAZvuIRfjdjNUdgwfZRqX6YeloPc-fkLSrzPVfMhTn3d8Ni-1a8Hbg9wMhHsnXqy-V8LFwETLC-3JCVsi2WO9OQEpbLor_EacBl05_bEgbBZK-rvZv6PSW0AieHvnktXQyqVtlWfhlQpq2AktXslTU4JSlmnEAnBE6gD3QCOJv5ZnZ3cJmCL9IzZ4pPRRmgM8kXvXzE8UdXeIGGzpXD2qJkr68UvxgkIcu0nxeQb1dTyH8VoPPg3af)[FINISH READING ON FOXNEWS.COM](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=8e271653affb4e60a4b697b772a3d9a1&_e=SuNI24LDKEUAZvuIRfjdjNUdgwfZRqX6YeloPc-fkLTS-hDFguOnK7ursKRH5zqydG55-HCVxhONmR_QB3ySkejBa6hPHPoU6O8eQqejIjQvzeL82KKMY8-IHPU_stL5DbJ_JtThkW3gMasPeCFTCz9EtZ2fm_kMtBaMCQS9JXY-BReOKdr9vv6xJzKCe2HmM7TlkILAY39MK7r0HeFr6X1hzzyQy12jb3v4gOFqSstcHauiR0kNko1Ox2CxF8aFJbTxvj8DjevvV4w4_paaiQ%3D%3D)**

name: Shift WA
subject: Rally for the citizen’s initiatives right to be heard!
body:
Democrats have agreed to only hear three of the six initiatives on February 27th and 28th. Unfortunately, their constitutional duty remains unfulfilled for the other three initiatives. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62841071:WV0lyciNR:m:1:2610672541:91D5557593298546C43424D4707887B3:r "Shift Washington")
---
| Friends,

As you likely know, the Secretary of State officially certified signatures for all six "Let's Go Washington" initiatives to the legislature back in January. However, despite that certification, majority Democrats have neglected their constitutional duty to allow all six initiatives to be heard and acted on for weeks now.

Thanks to persistent pressure from the public (and Republican lawmakers), Democrats have finally agreed to hear three of the initiatives on February 27th and 28th. The initiatives to be discussed include I-2113 (allowing police pursuits), I-2111 (banning all future income taxes), and I-2081 (ensuring parental rights in K-12 education).

Unfortunately, the Democrats' constitutional duty remains unfulfilled for the other three initiatives, including I-2117 (repealing the carbon tax), I-2124 (allowing employees to opt out of the state-run long-term care tax), and I-2109 (repealing the state income tax on capital gains). The Democrats don't want to hear from the voters on these three initiatives, but citizens will have the opportunity to voice their opinions on all six this November.

_**To highlight public support for hearings for all the Let's Go Washington initiatives, an Olympia rally is scheduled this Friday, February 23rd, at noon on the Capitol Building steps.**_

We encourage you to attend and make your voice heard.

For those planning to join, Shift WA would love to see your experience at the rally. **Please email us your photos from Friday to **[**info@shiftwa.org**](mailto:info@shiftwa.org)**. We may feature your photo in our weekly Sunday email!**

Thank you for your ongoing support,

The Shift WA team

| [ DONATE ](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62841072:WV0lyciNR:m:1:2610672541:91D5557593298546C43424D4707887B3:r)

You can also stay up to date on our efforts to shift the debate in Washington State by following us on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/shiftwa/) & [Twitter](https://twitter.com/ShiftWA). If you believe you received this message in error or no longer wish to receive emails from Shift Washington, [click to unsubscribe](http://click.shiftwa.org/p/oWV0lyciNR).

**FALSE:** McCormick lives in Connecticut and bragged about spending only half his time in the Commonwealth.

body:
Today, I’m taking the former Speaker’s advice: I’m asking for help. Not from lobbyists or party leaders but from the people I work for. Help from you, Fellow American. | [Unsubscribe](http://links.justandfreegop.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_s=2ee884d478184f459a47c95c18ce6e51&_t=2Kk0NKHEtMFlS60JXr8_IrSueBJxhgNfaCNhagjAlzVdOzvCWTSVWVRQE2_hE22WFCAlk9mZYzRvh8Fp2sPjCCrerQiAw-GTCoVcRR5Q0ew%3D) | [Mark as Junk](http://links.justandfreegop.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_s=2ee884d478184f459a47c95c18ce6e51&_t=2Kk0NKHEtMFlS60JXr8_IrSueBJxhgNfaCNhagjAlzVdOzvCWTSVWVRQE2_hE22WFCAlk9mZYzRvh8Fp2sPjCCrerQiAw-GTCoVcRR5Q0ew%3D)
[ ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=2ee884d478184f459a47c95c18ce6e51&_e=eUKEEOsDJIDFe3DrJTCRXhMK_w55fdaO44NjUQ2rcTJbHZxvmaGEfD9rIW9ZMo_domtvak4Sg63KhjHf8sLNuljT4bKNCrv9m64QQ2MU_cg06ouQIupp1lWVCLm5PXOISEyKQ0g9M1Y49Og6vT6LOUHcsS16SheNv3qGMGVznb0NV5SFNfUxaaFQV229AIV1q4SLoy8gUz6xY955crzXuLtMK8E0qIfxsIV_BTpglWd_b8Htos1jGf5JjjUVWOmoiYTHtYOOyB7Dj41cJsMWuQiwVWRsSf8QLlC9WYGZMqgS2M9NyHq6azq4mKEompwSJEk4XiscFAX8QwAsndT6_lWPil7WpTQr-gfNEOMYbdmt5he0LiHuJVDgA83EFDJ9)
---
**_"I hope Nancy gets the help she needs. I really do... She’s got a lot of challenges." -FORMER Speaker of the House, Kevin McCarthy_**

This aint my first rodeo, Fellow American.

I’m used to people underestimating me. _Truly!_

I didn’t become the first woman to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets by having a lot of people believe in me.

I didn’t pick myself up after dropping out of high school and go waitress at Waffle House to put food on the table because of handouts.

I didn’t become a strong conservative FIGHTER in Washington DC because I didn’t face challenges.

**_NOPE!_**

I got to where I am because I am a fighter. I’m not afraid to get dirt under my fingernails and sweat on my brow for the things that I believe in. _**And I believe in America.**_ I will fight until the day I die for what is RIGHT in this country – _and I’m not a sell-out to corporate greed like the former Speaker._

Which is why he is coming after me on his revenge tour. I can’t be bought. My vote is not for sale. I work for the American people and the American people ONLY. _Which frankly scares the HECK out of people here in Washington who aren’t used to people they cannot control._

**So, today, I’m taking the former Speaker’s advice:** [**I’m asking for help._Not from lobbyists or party leaders but from the people I work for._ Help from you, Fellow American.**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=2ee884d478184f459a47c95c18ce6e51&_e=eUKEEOsDJIDFe3DrJTCRXhMK_w55fdaO44NjUQ2rcTJbHZxvmaGEfD9rIW9ZMo_domtvak4Sg63KhjHf8sLNuljT4bKNCrv9m64QQ2MU_cg06ouQIupp1lWVCLm5PXOISEyKQ0g9M1Y49Og6vT6LOUHcsS16SheNv3qGMGVznb0NV5SFNfUxaaFQV229AIV1q4SLoy8gUz6xY955crzXuLtMK8E0qIfxsIV_BTpglWfxHmRVsV-suMoyexSaO2s2Ie2ytakQfOhZQ65kh8kPyG183_oPVuGMMvF8d4A_dltAsjMY1Mre_iORaUM1gWcxoPBaLxCp2d2SzohpHQqyeZ6fvj0aRYNHipfXbbchFd5zjJPKr8dBuatEZQXkOCnQ)

Everyone in Washington is after me. They are throwing MILLIONS of dollars against me, but I don’t care because I know I can rely on you to help me claw my way back to Washington and keep fighting the good fight. [**Any amount you can spare today, even if it’s just sharing my story, would mean the world to me.**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=2ee884d478184f459a47c95c18ce6e51&_e=eUKEEOsDJIDFe3DrJTCRXhMK_w55fdaO44NjUQ2rcTJbHZxvmaGEfD9rIW9ZMo_domtvak4Sg63KhjHf8sLNuljT4bKNCrv9m64QQ2MU_cg06ouQIupp1lWVCLm5PXOISEyKQ0g9M1Y49Og6vT6LOUHcsS16SheNv3qGMGVznb0NV5SFNfUxaaFQV229AIV1q4SLoy8gUz6xY955crzXuLtMK8E0qIfxsIV_BTpglWdp7j8aXb87KX49LATC6LWB5G_XJhS3UeFDGxcyKDDl1EO0ZgPKD6KhyKpVKanv_aXl5_pxOdZHy_vYGQ7WvnQ5Xh6LLgdylAdjb_jJT5HDpj_PxkD6UL-qe2seixsJ4kAbosDfN9zv7z14ClU-Rsk6)

Representative Scholten is flailing. This week, Governor Whitmer’s administration asked Michiganders to ‘volunteer’ to house illegal migrants. | | | | | [](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=df251f814f&e=26f66c7cbd)
---
**Hudson: Rep. Scholten ‘Flailing’ on Immigration as Crisis Hits Michigan****–GOP Challenger Demands Accountability on Failed Immigration Policy–**
**Grand Rapids, MI** – “On the most pressing crisis of the day—securing our border—Representative Scholten is flailing. This week, Governor Whitmer’s administration asked Michiganders to ‘volunteer’ to house illegal migrants in their homes. [[1](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=3a02ca30c5&e=26f66c7cbd)] Michigan residents are generous people, but a welcoming spirit should not be confused with serious immigration policy.
Having created a national crisis through an open-border policy, the government is now asking Michigan citizens to individually and personally shoulder the consequences. The border crisis has finally hit home, 2,000 miles away, with Hillary Scholten and the Biden administration to blame.
Rep. Scholten recently feigned frustration at Congress’ lack of action: ‘Unacceptable. We have an immigration crisis in our country that demands IMMEDIATE action. Speaker Johnson, we've had enough of the partisan games and delay. Put the bipartisan Dignity Act on the floor for a vote to help fix this crisis.’ [[2](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=6412473af6&e=26f66c7cbd)]
“Scholten must think voters aren’t paying attention,” Hudson observed. “Does Hillary Scholten think voters are unaware that a year ago she voted against HR 2, the ‘Secure the Border Act,’ which the House of Representatives passed over her No vote? If she wanted ‘IMMEDIATE’ action, where was she a year ago?”
“If Congresswoman Scholten—who boasts about her expertise as an immigration attorney working at the Michigan Immigrant Rights Center [[3]](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=a367a9792f&e=26f66c7cbd)—was actually serious about securing the border, she would have known within the first year of the Biden administration that this problem would soon become untenable and would not have voted against border security legislation last year before the crisis became an election issue. Her actions, inaction, and silence have contributed to the ongoing catastrophe, with nearly 10 million illegal crossings causing a national crisis. Now that the issue is on our front doorstep, Hillary Scholten has conveniently decided to end her silence.”
Hudson continued, “Congresswoman Scholten pretends to be bipartisan and complains about ‘partisan games and delay,’ but then turns around and votes party-line 96% of the time. [[4](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=08504711ab&e=26f66c7cbd)] West Michigan voters can see through the act. The truth is that when it came time to actually work with her colleagues across the aisle on significant border-security legislation, Hillary offered no serious amendments or solutions—just obstruction, political theater, and show-bills that have zero chance at becoming law.”
Hudson concluded that “Most complex problems have complex causes, but when it comes to the crisis at the border, this time it’s pretty simple: We have a border crisis because of the open-border philosophy of Hillary Scholten and the Biden administration. They own it, and now they’re putting the burden of their failures on the people of Michigan.”
Paul Hudson, a lifelong Michigander, is seeking the Republican nomination for Congress in the state’s Third District. The [GOP primary election](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=f0642e1b9b&e=26f66c7cbd) is Tuesday, August 6, 2024.# # # **Follow Paul Hudson:**[**Twitter**](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=af59399116&e=26f66c7cbd)**|**[**Campaign Website**](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=2c1b54787a&e=26f66c7cbd)**|**[**Facebook**](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=2d70183e4d&e=26f66c7cbd)

**_"I hope Nancy gets the help she needs. I really do... She’s got a lot of challenges." -FORMER Speaker of the House, Kevin McCarthy_**

This aint my first rodeo, Fellow American.

I’m used to people underestimating me. _Truly!_

I didn’t become the first woman to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets by having a lot of people believe in me.

I didn’t pick myself up after dropping out of high school and go waitress at Waffle House to put food on the table because of handouts.

I didn’t become a strong conservative FIGHTER in Washington DC because I didn’t face challenges.

**_NOPE!_**

I got to where I am because I am a fighter. I’m not afraid to get dirt under my fingernails and sweat on my brow for the things that I believe in. _**And I believe in America.**_ I will fight until the day I die for what is RIGHT in this country – _and I’m not a sell-out to corporate greed like the former Speaker._

Which is why he is coming after me on his revenge tour. I can’t be bought. My vote is not for sale. I work for the American people and the American people ONLY. _Which frankly scares the HECK out of people here in Washington who aren’t used to people they cannot control._

**So, today, I’m taking the former Speaker’s advice:** [**I’m asking for help._Not from lobbyists or party leaders but from the people I work for._ Help from you, Fellow American.**](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=96bc4b9744e1425daf7e9de1c32a4239&_e=2fyYUXtczVzQzxMV93oYwGK4KT9jCIoA02_V82dOLgGkS5H5kCTs9LM9Oxve-g9_U9-O2jrJVzDtwmOEmUalOvzvxS3JPxV6ZZFkyGmGnqR_qkm6FIo0ZFaJ2dsOIhYmjRHzrEvg1l-5xjeEqAefEr0P4gPdbZSExGqtL0rUtU176xorlHHygcV9-DeMfVQbnCgUvVU3iVOUaN62U0D86fHK4wkHj_yQzODY-QSY6Y0eLiMUGREFwX8vT6M6FDTzbq-JxRC77Oxb_uepE9WfXkOMAuX9i_Zd8eOiB5-iN88NYUi9UkHIX5fkwRS26YsJHlrSFbnNcfUDNqosbEhEIRYurcVuNKbw_V_vNn_1AfccPVhR_z5rBoV7BLsbWWwk)

Everyone in Washington is after me. They are throwing MILLIONS of dollars against me, but I don’t care because I know I can rely on you to help me claw my way back to Washington and keep fighting the good fight. [**Any amount you can spare today, even if it’s just sharing my story, would mean the world to me.**](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=96bc4b9744e1425daf7e9de1c32a4239&_e=2fyYUXtczVzQzxMV93oYwGK4KT9jCIoA02_V82dOLgGkS5H5kCTs9LM9Oxve-g9_U9-O2jrJVzDtwmOEmUalOvzvxS3JPxV6ZZFkyGmGnqR_qkm6FIo0ZFaJ2dsOIhYmjRHzrEvg1l-5xjeEqAefEr0P4gPdbZSExGqtL0rUtU176xorlHHygcV9-DeMfVQbnCgUvVU3iVOUaN62U0D86fHK4wkHj_yQzODY-QSY6Y3x92rLv-tcSNq0SGNMk0s7NqlNRhzfWgntXt_P0GpGhDn1LvHWncxKNPRpYqeYxHHA-jclDfd0Rky_1zkyBywc8i9YLOPtgMupL68EH472-2OUDbF9HtanY3GduQsCU8oHGgdkZYCJG5MxepClGFIz)

[** ****SEND ME BACK TO WASHINGTON » **](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=96bc4b9744e1425daf7e9de1c32a4239&_e=2fyYUXtczVzQzxMV93oYwGK4KT9jCIoA02_V82dOLgGkS5H5kCTs9LM9Oxve-g9_U9-O2jrJVzDtwmOEmUalOvzvxS3JPxV6ZZFkyGmGnqR_qkm6FIo0ZFaJ2dsOIhYmjRHzrEvg1l-5xjeEqAefEr0P4gPdbZSExGqtL0rUtU176xorlHHygcV9-DeMfVQbnCgUvVU3iVOUaN62U0D86fHK4wkHj_yQzODY-QSY6Y38UAaQp9RBRj2VLO5GTCyP-7_7jXwm3wex3E1hhrhhM5XbRnil-LeiRvRiIdHGZTSp7yXnFb_jp6kz5jS1oO1Kx0sMw6BAxlssqJEmWZd-gq0B3mM49esM2CDjEHlPuDT9PqsallA2kr_Xb6JMNOVA)

body:
No matter where we live, gun violence affects us all.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=971%2E62735%2Ebg9e7f)
Peter —
There have now been more mass shootings in America than there have been days in the year — another infuriating reminder that gun violence affects communities everywhere.
Enough is enough. If our leaders won’t deliver the change we need, Peter, _maybe we need to change our leaders._ **That’s why I’m running for Senate: to put a stop to the revolving door of bought-and-paid-for politicians who don’t have the courage to take action, even to save American lives.**
**[I know you’re with me on this, so I’ll get straight to it. I need you to sign my petition calling on our leaders to take _immediate_ action to address America’s gun violence epidemic >>>](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_PET_GunViolencePetition_022124/?source=em_HHR_PET_GunViolencePetition_022124&t=2&akid=971%2E62735%2Ebg9e7f)**
**[SIGN THE PETITION »](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_PET_GunViolencePetition_022124/?source=em_HHR_PET_GunViolencePetition_022124&t=3&akid=971%2E62735%2Ebg9e7f)**
I drive my son to school every morning, Peter, and I will never forget the day he told me that he was afraid to go — after repeated active shooting drills. My heart sank into my stomach; the devastation of hearing a child, a _first-grader_ , express fear for their safety at school is something no parent is prepared to handle.
But that’s the reality in today’s broken political system: **Our kids are being traumatized every day because of gun violence that establishment politicians refuse to address.**
**This issue is so personal to me, and I’ll work tirelessly in the Senate to ban weapons of mass murder and end the gun violence epidemic in our communities.** Because every American deserves to go to school, to church, to work — and yes, to Super Bowl parades — without the looming fear of gun violence. _Period._
**[Please, sign my petition and tell our leaders to take _immediate_ action to address America’s gun violence epidemic.](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_PET_GunViolencePetition_022124/?source=em_HHR_PET_GunViolencePetition_022124&t=4&akid=971%2E62735%2Ebg9e7f)**
**[SIGN THE PETITION »](https://act.hillharper.com/survey/em_HHR_PET_GunViolencePetition_022124/?source=em_HHR_PET_GunViolencePetition_022124&t=5&akid=971%2E62735%2Ebg9e7f)**
I won’t be bought, bossed, or bullied by the NRA or the gun lobby; and in the Senate, I’ll fight to pass the common-sense gun legislation that we need to keep our kids and our communities safe.
Thanks for signing on.
Hill Harper
Democrat for U.S. Senate

| [H.B. 187](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001iZ3QJVBC61v0VB1pRB4C93cHa6rZWT_l_N_CrAakBx6WNcfJT2DdaJ72YbchLkVUK3r7ZZ0wrVg2gWBhMdMZbNML60HmF2SXXI-H2mI6ezDXcnP_ZYNClfyFvDWGheqGMcOfHKh7Prt05-bmPSUqV3iSIQLtaF5MT4mUY7j3lgruEtl3xeVg3a-2YoJEYRusYl6knls7_Wk=&c=mrDQmbmpAHvNe8LUnkJUTTSrDhu1QHdYpt30mgGcqRD5Sx0xRzQE8A==&ch=D0cLqDqF3TmgydWnM9H-qtRK3_ejs_hYPUjfBf1iwtmWaFQ-HbQqfQ==) Patron: Clark Average teacher salary in the Commonwealth; national average. Requires the Governor's introduced budget bills for the 2025, 2026, and 2027 Regular Sessions of the General Assembly to propose funding for, and state funding to be provided pursuant to the general appropriation act enacted during any regular or special session of the General Assembly during 2025, 2026, or 2027 to fund, the Commonwealth's share of compensation supplement incentives for Standards of Quality-funded instructional and support positions sufficient to increase the average teacher salary in the Commonwealth to at least the national average teacher salary by the end of the 2026-2028 biennium and establishes a detailed timeline and process for satisfying such requirement. A BILL to establish a process and timeline for increasing the average teacher salary in the Commonwealth to at least the national average teacher salary.24107278D
[H.B. 224](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001iZ3QJVBC61v0VB1pRB4C93cHa6rZWT_l_N_CrAakBx6WNcfJT2DdaCurfKD4q4oPY49469O8hmSac6OzpOqN4nDOcQHx31V4ZbQaeVY-kTty_O_C-XVJ2LWipoKlY96oiOvP3P_hHKuQm6h0YAxO0VKEAJvZYHMdznSHq4zvkhSrXh1_BzO9kxuyhd_gp-LeST2Z1VxQZsQ=&c=mrDQmbmpAHvNe8LUnkJUTTSrDhu1QHdYpt30mgGcqRD5Sx0xRzQE8A==&ch=D0cLqDqF3TmgydWnM9H-qtRK3_ejs_hYPUjfBf1iwtmWaFQ-HbQqfQ==) Patron: Henson Public schools; teachers and other relevant personnel; mental health awareness training. Requires each teacher and other relevant personnel, as determined by the applicable school board, employed on a full-time basis to complete mental health awareness training that addresses the needs of youth populations that are at a high risk of experiencing mental health challenges and disorders. Current law requires such teachers and personnel to complete mental health awareness training but does not contain any requirements relating to the specific topics such training must address. A BILL to amend and reenact § [22.1-298.6](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001iZ3QJVBC61v0VB1pRB4C93cHa6rZWT_l_N_CrAakBx6WNcfJT2DdaCurfKD4q4oPVKt9XtpRgC5ZkPpBtf4l-JEF8Pr6eDAnf25tNdVOoio6zKkBZCPIQAZ4uZYymIIV2YGbWihIYR6UZLJ9w3eyD9w8OcdcS1VloPJafs3hSx4rh4q19yNu8w==&c=mrDQmbmpAHvNe8LUnkJUTTSrDhu1QHdYpt30mgGcqRD5Sx0xRzQE8A==&ch=D0cLqDqF3TmgydWnM9H-qtRK3_ejs_hYPUjfBf1iwtmWaFQ-HbQqfQ==) of the Code of Virginia, relating to public schools; mental health awareness training and instruction; requirements.24105961D
[H.B. 474](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001iZ3QJVBC61v0VB1pRB4C93cHa6rZWT_l_N_CrAakBx6WNcfJT2DdaJ72YbchLkVUH7-8emtN4DnGyqpWERGmLWvEJpd2Etf0zNVG6O24QXYTUhKeiifORcIPDhhrS1_zdxKIQJbTdW8DktLzfUXuT5C782TiyyMusxIRZl0GscqukJzmu13FhqZibHpCM8Ht9ho_aWStfEk=&c=mrDQmbmpAHvNe8LUnkJUTTSrDhu1QHdYpt30mgGcqRD5Sx0xRzQE8A==&ch=D0cLqDqF3TmgydWnM9H-qtRK3_ejs_hYPUjfBf1iwtmWaFQ-HbQqfQ==) Patron: Coyner Restroom Access Act. Requires a retail establishment that does not have a public restroom but has an employee toilet facility to allow any customer with an eligible medical condition, as defined in the bill, to use such employee toilet facility during normal business hours if certain conditions are met. A customer who suffers loss as a result of a violation may bring an action to recover damages not to exceed $100. A BILL to amend the Code of Virginia by adding in Title 59.1 a chapter numbered 57, consisting of sections numbered [59.1-603](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001iZ3QJVBC61v0VB1pRB4C93cHa6rZWT_l_N_CrAakBx6WNcfJT2DdaJ72YbchLkVUQl7tKPAxgMYKWPPCMXqXDb9XNBoDcBqdAiPbhqE8bOQ0YGClBTa0jGQy8UfmmcxT6fMe4j0COYKMFYykWyjjwLwvqqCtoYzySaG08QGEl1Q=&c=mrDQmbmpAHvNe8LUnkJUTTSrDhu1QHdYpt30mgGcqRD5Sx0xRzQE8A==&ch=D0cLqDqF3TmgydWnM9H-qtRK3_ejs_hYPUjfBf1iwtmWaFQ-HbQqfQ==) through [59.1-606](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001iZ3QJVBC61v0VB1pRB4C93cHa6rZWT_l_N_CrAakBx6WNcfJT2DdaJ72YbchLkVUsArUirdv0vHa1OoHw4b_0Fssp_UV2FiQ8u48_O76R5APOxKed2GnaR1Ykhpbfr29ROAV594bot5BhKHChtdwO2h-5gskW75nrZCi7esQ_Lo=&c=mrDQmbmpAHvNe8LUnkJUTTSrDhu1QHdYpt30mgGcqRD5Sx0xRzQE8A==&ch=D0cLqDqF3TmgydWnM9H-qtRK3_ejs_hYPUjfBf1iwtmWaFQ-HbQqfQ==), relating to Restroom Access Act.24106961D
[H.B. 519](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001iZ3QJVBC61v0VB1pRB4C93cHa6rZWT_l_N_CrAakBx6WNcfJT2DdaJ72YbchLkVUaVg5LrX0TmOpRlJcjfRKpom7RX_JadpDHqqrIzNijCP0CACNARztZkcssfDEqcK5V0apUmuTs0H88zg38G8sLs4lM1lRJf8dVsDRfWHqq3euD1F9Oc47-cuKtQnp4y-jwdADh0dG7x0=&c=mrDQmbmpAHvNe8LUnkJUTTSrDhu1QHdYpt30mgGcqRD5Sx0xRzQE8A==&ch=D0cLqDqF3TmgydWnM9H-qtRK3_ejs_hYPUjfBf1iwtmWaFQ-HbQqfQ==) Patron: Mundon King Board of Medicine; unprofessional conduct. Prohibits the Board of Medicine from taking disciplinary action against a doctor based on the alleged provision or receipt of abortion care that is not prohibited under the laws of the Commonwealth, regardless of where such abortion care was provided or received. The bill also specifies that grounds for refusal to issue a certificate or license to any applicant or to take disciplinary action for procuring or performing an abortion apply to such action only as it is prohibited by the laws of the Commonwealth. Provides that no demand for extradition of a person charged with a criminal violation of the law of another state shall be recognized by the Governor if such alleged violation involves the receipt of or assistance with reproductive health care services, defined in the bill, within the Commonwealth unless the alleged criminal violation would also constitute a criminal offense under the laws of the Commonwealth. The bill also provides that such limit on extradition shall not apply when the person who is subject to such demand for extradition by another state was physically present in the demanding state at the time of the commission of the alleged offense and thereafter fled from such state. Requires the Governor's introduced budget bills for the 2025, 2026, and 2027 Regular Sessions of the General Assembly to propose funding for, and state funding to be provided pursuant to the general appropriation act enacted during any regular or special session of the General Assembly during 2025, 2026, or 2027 to fund, the Commonwealth's share of compensation supplement incentives for Standards of Quality-funded instructional and support positions sufficient to increase the average teacher salary in the Commonwealth to at least the national average teacher salary by the end of the 2026-2028 biennium and establishes a detailed timeline and process for satisfying such requirement. A BILL to establish a process and timeline for increasing the average teacher salary in the Commonwealth to at least the national average teacher salary.24107278D == Patron: Henson Public schools; teachers and other relevant personnel; mental health awareness training. Requires each teacher and other relevant personnel, as determined by the applicable school board, employed on a full-time basis to complete mental health awareness training that addresses the needs of youth populations that are at a high risk of experiencing mental health challenges and disorders. Current law requires such teachers and personnel to complete mental health awareness training but does not contain any requirements relating to the specific topics such training must address. A BILL to amend and reenact § == of the Code of Virginia, relating to public schools; mental health awareness training and instruction; requirements.24105961D == Patron: Coyner Restroom Access Act. Requires a retail establishment that does not have a public restroom but has an employee toilet facility to allow any customer with an eligible medical condition, as defined in the bill, to use such employee toilet facility during normal business hours if certain conditions are met. A customer who suffers loss as a result of a violation may bring an action to recover damages not to exceed $100. A BILL to amend the Code of Virginia by adding in Title 59.1 a chapter numbered 57, consisting of sections numbered == through ==, relating to Restroom Access Act.24106961D == Patron: Mundon King Board of Medicine; unprofessional conduct. Prohibits the Board of Medicine from taking disciplinary action against a doctor based on the alleged provision or receipt of abortion care that is not prohibited under the laws of the Commonwealth, regardless of where such abortion care was provided or received. The bill also specifies that grounds for refusal to issue a certificate or license to any applicant or to take disciplinary action for procuring or performing an abortion apply to such action only as it is prohibited by the laws of the Commonwealth. Under current law, such grounds for refusal or disciplinary action apply for procuring or performing a criminal abortion. A BILL to amend and reenact § == of the Code of Virginia, relating to Board of Medicine; unprofessional conduct.24103442D == Patron: Delaney Policies on parental notification of instructional material that includes sexually explicit content; scope and use. Provides that nothing in the law requiring the Department of Education to develop and make available to each school board model policies for ensuring parental notification of any instructional material that includes sexually explicit content and requiring each school board to adopt policies that are consistent with but may be more comprehensive than such model policies or that is in such model policies or school board policies shall be construed to permit the censoring of books in any public elementary or secondary school. A BILL to amend and reenact § == of the Code of Virginia, relating to policies on parental notification of instructional material that includes sexually explicit content; scope and use.24102157D == Patron: Price Public elementary and secondary schools; health instruction, certain topics relating to mental health. Requires health instruction provided to elementary and secondary school students to include certain topics relating to mental health that are enumerated in the bill, including (i) general themes of social and emotional learning, including self-awareness, self-management, responsible decision making, relationship skills, and social awareness; (ii) signs and symptoms of common mental health challenges; and (iii) mental health wellness and healthy strategies for coping with stress and negative feelings, including conflict resolution skills. A BILL to amend and reenact § == of the Code of Virginia, relating to public schools; health instruction; certain topics relating to mental health.24106110D == Patron: Price Contraception; right to contraception; applicability; enforcement. Establishes a right to obtain contraceptives and engage in contraception, as defined in the bill. The bill creates a cause of action that may be instituted against anyone who infringes on such right. A BILL to amend the Code of Virginia by adding in Title 32.1 a chapter numbered 21, consisting of sections numbered ==, ==, and ==, relating to contraception; right to contraception; applicability; enforcement.24102170D == Patron: Srinivasan School boards; model memorandum of understanding; partnerships with certain mental health service providers; provision and expansion of virtual mental health services. Directs the Department, in consultation with the Department of Behavioral Health and Developmental Services and the Department of Medical Assistance Services, to develop, adopt, and distribute to each school board a model memorandum of understanding between a school board and a nationally recognized school-based telehealth provider that sets forth the parameters for the provision of mental health teletherapy to public school students enrolled in the local school division by such provider. Current law only requires the development, adoption, and distribution of a model memorandum of understanding between a school board and a public or private community mental health services provider. The bill also permits each school board to adopt policies and procedures to increase the accessibility of school-based mental health services for students enrolled in each school division that may not have access to mental health services otherwise by providing or expanding virtual mental health resources and establishing or expanding a partnership with a community mental health service provider or a nationally recognized school-based telehealth provider that provides mental health teletherapy to students. A BILL to amend and reenact § == of the Code of Virginia, relating to school boards; model memorandum of understanding; partnerships with certain mental health service providers; provision and expansion of virtual mental health services.24103336D == Patron: Simon Abortion or other reproductive health care services; prohibitions on extradition for certain crimes; prohibited practices under Virginia Consumer Protection Act. Provides that no demand for extradition of a person charged with a criminal violation of the law of another state shall be recognized by the Governor if such alleged violation involves the receipt of or assistance with reproductive health care services, defined in the bill, within the Commonwealth unless the alleged criminal violation would also constitute a criminal offense under the laws of the Commonwealth. The bill also provides that such limit on extradition shall not apply when the person who is subject to such demand for extradition by another state was physically present in the demanding state at the time of the commission of the alleged offense and thereafter fled from such state. The bill adds obtaining, disclosing, selling, or disseminating certain enumerated personal reproductive or sexual health information without the consent of the consumer as a prohibited practice under the Virginia Consumer Protection Act. This bill incorporates HB 1493. body:
Texas may not allow for citizen-led ballot initiatives. But abortion is still on the ballot.
#
In the year and a half since the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , Americans in at least seven states have weighed in on citizen-led ballot initiatives regarding abortion rights.
Every time that abortion has been on the ballot — from California and Ohio to ruby-red Kansas and Kentucky — voters have overwhelmingly chosen to protect a woman’s freedom to make her own decisions about her own body.
Unfortunately, we can’t replicate this model in Texas. Only the state legislature can propose constitutional amendments — and the majority-Republican House and Senate have blocked all efforts to place an abortion amendment on the ballot.
**That means that the only way to restore abortion rights in Texas is to change who’s in power.**
That's why Powered by People is training thousands of Volunteer Deputy Registrars (VDRs) who will help register and turn out the Democratic voters we need to get this done.
The more VDRs that sign up, the more voters we can reach. The more voters we can reach, the less time it will take to build a majority of pro-choice leaders in Texas.
**Can we count on you to sponsor our VDR program?**

**_"I hope Nancy gets the help she needs. I really do... She’s got a lot of challenges." -FORMER Speaker of the House, Kevin McCarthy_**

This aint my first rodeo, Fellow American.

I’m used to people underestimating me. _Truly!_

I didn’t become the first woman to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets by having a lot of people believe in me.

I didn’t pick myself up after dropping out of high school and go waitress at Waffle House to put food on the table because of handouts.

I didn’t become a strong conservative FIGHTER in Washington DC because I didn’t face challenges.

**_NOPE!_**

I got to where I am because I am a fighter. I’m not afraid to get dirt under my fingernails and sweat on my brow for the things that I believe in. _**And I believe in America.**_ I will fight until the day I die for what is RIGHT in this country – _and I’m not a sell-out to corporate greed like the former Speaker._

Which is why he is coming after me on his revenge tour. I can’t be bought. My vote is not for sale. I work for the American people and the American people ONLY. _Which frankly scares the HECK out of people here in Washington who aren’t used to people they cannot control._

**So, today, I’m taking the former Speaker’s advice:** [**I’m asking for help._Not from lobbyists or party leaders but from the people I work for._ Help from you, Fellow American.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=7cf47082b30f44c1b33391fa91e49c12&_e=UigxLZcilSKKymmo0SVKhOpxbRHQESfR9mm1-AnlSe9Mylw5ieAbCV_qmBuMH3ghCrM-p2CV0cC3ddJwWkKI4vqHDLUt03MRrUZUzSYfM8PU1E3bLjOgH6970lXc-oeJYvJL5Gg-Vjk3PORBi0jlwh0QwCnKd61LGq5bUurkxS2LaWxxbhympaFPy0fzm6WeV7_0NkElQdXQHjldrY8DcZQVK4-r2oq8w8RRllzjacKYS1ywQJR6sCAGVSzomMqs0nB9hoklItvZ7S8FnM-5HHRccTmvNu8R3BACGIMlXAuEfo9D5eImEhfQto4_MBZR_6L7M55n_axth8jJ0-HRPfYUbSqBaKfdSFXtDXqXLku0YNyR3vEwMjlKc5Rw5jY1)

Everyone in Washington is after me. They are throwing MILLIONS of dollars against me, but I don’t care because I know I can rely on you to help me claw my way back to Washington and keep fighting the good fight. [**Any amount you can spare today, even if it’s just sharing my story, would mean the world to me.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=7cf47082b30f44c1b33391fa91e49c12&_e=UigxLZcilSKKymmo0SVKhOpxbRHQESfR9mm1-AnlSe9Mylw5ieAbCV_qmBuMH3ghCrM-p2CV0cC3ddJwWkKI4vqHDLUt03MRrUZUzSYfM8PU1E3bLjOgH6970lXc-oeJYvJL5Gg-Vjk3PORBi0jlwh0QwCnKd61LGq5bUurkxS2LaWxxbhympaFPy0fzm6WeV7_0NkElQdXQHjldrY8DcZQVK4-r2oq8w8RRllzjacKSh5nBVTY7ijCc-n9UH1V8ZJoZzVAF7oDvonkJx9-_2fSVx74TMR5iC_Pgqu3NLG4xfA7Hr6tfEZ03V5xv5-gGebuWRZW6nJwDXYaQQp0vEgvh5iL-CxptrTJxRHrAjHHpCbCgN10EYw6VZIpUG3N3)

[** ****SEND ME BACK TO WASHINGTON » **](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=7cf47082b30f44c1b33391fa91e49c12&_e=UigxLZcilSKKymmo0SVKhOpxbRHQESfR9mm1-AnlSe9Mylw5ieAbCV_qmBuMH3ghCrM-p2CV0cC3ddJwWkKI4vqHDLUt03MRrUZUzSYfM8PU1E3bLjOgH6970lXc-oeJYvJL5Gg-Vjk3PORBi0jlwh0QwCnKd61LGq5bUurkxS2LaWxxbhympaFPy0fzm6WeV7_0NkElQdXQHjldrY8DcZQVK4-r2oq8w8RRllzjacLODVKXL2h68-RvwoCX8LyLAcLOjygEkOC3f_pTQtodGEft05Z0XWwqxDnSBsH8ziwgSkH-zfQVciBmD82w7QhZW4_Kmc0FUy5ELdeFmKlFsuND_7Fnep0jV0hwchyd1FgeeOczfvc2zpyZhDhtP4NC)

She is a proud mother of two, the first female to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets, and a tough conservative who wants to save our country from the radicals who hate America! | As I look ahead to November 2025, there’s no doubt my race will be a close one — just like my races in 2018, 2020, and 2022.

However, now I am running for an even bigger seat and to represent even more Virginians (well, all of them!). To win in this competitive race, people need to know who I am, how hard I am working for them, and why I’m running to be the next Governor of Virginia.

Already, I’m hearing directly from voters on the issues that are most important to them – supporting our public schools, protecting our democracy, reducing gun violence, safeguarding voting rights and reproductive rights, and so much more. From Carroll County to Chesapeake to Charlottesville and everywhere in between – I can’t wait to meet everyone!

Since I’m now running to represent the entire Commonwealth, not just the Seventh District, I have many new voters, community leaders, and organizations to meet, and I need your support to make sure our campaign has the resources necessary to reach every voter across our Commonwealth.

Our Michigan newsroom explains how Republicans will ban abortion – even in legal states like Michigan

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79458339/456522624/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGY1NGIwZTYtZjNkMC1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Y3sggYV1mhGe1hGp6JeeyXp1vhjnXqDqFQDBT6Omh0A=&emci=7f54b0e6-f3d0-ee11-85f9-002248223794&emdi=8f54b0e6-f3d0-ee11-85f9-002248223794&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
Last week, the COURIER team in Michigan exposed _Project 2025_ , a plan by the Republican party for the presidency if a Republican wins this November.
The project includes a convoluted plan to ban abortion nationwide:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79458340/456522625/-593472309?refcode=20240221-EM-Gander&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGY1NGIwZTYtZjNkMC1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Y3sggYV1mhGe1hGp6JeeyXp1vhjnXqDqFQDBT6Omh0A=)
_The 'Gander, February 13, 2024_
The gist of _Project 2025_ is that right-wing Republicans want to use a little-known and currently unenforced law – The Comstock Act – to make it illegal to ship “anything designed, adapted, or intended for producing abortion” across state lines. **The new interpretation of the law would criminalize shipping abortion medications and potentially medical equipment. Distressingly, it would also apply in states like Michigan, where abortion is legal and even constitutionally protected.**
After voting overwhelmingly to enshrine reproductive rights into Michigan’s constitution, **Michiganders have a right to know about right-wing efforts to take away their freedom. **
That’s why we’re proud of _The ‘Gander_ being one of the only local news organizations in the state to cover this important story.
[**Our newsroom _The ‘Gander_ focuses on the facts and then makes critical reporting freely available to communities in Michigan who don’t have access to trustworthy local news. Can you chip in $10 to fuel our work if you already support our mission?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79458341/456522626/-593472309?refcode=20240221-EM-Gander&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGY1NGIwZTYtZjNkMC1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Y3sggYV1mhGe1hGp6JeeyXp1vhjnXqDqFQDBT6Omh0A=)
Our coverage of reproductive rights in Michigan is nothing new. Since the right-wing Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , _The ‘Gander_ has relentlessly reported on Michigan’s push to increase abortion access – and the ensuing right-wing resistance.
**We know our mission to expose right-wing misinformation and election schemes is working because we tested it! **
In an experiment conducted by our research team during the 2022 midterm elections, we found that individuals who saw our factual stories on abortion rights were more likely to support Michigan’s Prop. 3, the law enshrining reproductive freedom into Michigan’s constitution.

clean_body: Our Michigan newsroom explains how Republicans will ban abortion – even in legal states like Michigan Peter, Last week, the COURIER team in Michigan exposed Project 2025 , a plan by the Republican party for the presidency if a Republican wins this November. The project includes a convoluted plan to ban abortion nationwide: = The 'Gander, February 13, 2024 The gist of Project 2025 is that right-wing Republicans want to use a little-known and currently unenforced law – The Comstock Act – to make it illegal to ship “anything designed, adapted, or intended for producing abortion” across state lines. The new interpretation of the law would criminalize shipping abortion medications and potentially medical equipment. Distressingly, it would also apply in states like Michigan, where abortion is legal and even constitutionally protected. After voting overwhelmingly to enshrine reproductive rights into Michigan’s constitution, Michiganders have a right to know about right-wing efforts to take away their freedom. That’s why we’re proud of The ‘Gander being one of the only local news organizations in the state to cover this important story. = Our coverage of reproductive rights in Michigan is nothing new. Since the right-wing Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade , The ‘Gander has relentlessly reported on Michigan’s push to increase abortion access – and the ensuing right-wing resistance. We know our mission to expose right-wing misinformation and election schemes is working because we tested it! subject: Update re: Jamaal’s primary fight
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Remember how Rep. Jamaal Bowman’s moderate, AIPAC-backed opponent made the
dangerous, baseless claim that Jamaal takes money from Hamas last week?
Well, he’s since double-downed on this racist, Islamophobic claim.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240221-jb.EVY8L6&refcode=em20240221-33440&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=33440%2E1203867%2E1Tz7Fw ]The Intercept: Primary challenger bankrolled by AIPAC says Jamaal
Bowman takes money from Hamas. George Latimer offered no evidence to back
up his allegation — and doubled down on his dark insinuations about
Bowman.

When Westchester County Executive and NY-16 congressional candidate George
Latimer was asked by a voter about taking $600,000 from anti-Palestinian
lobby group AIPAC at a Black History Month event, he lashed out and
accused Jamaal of taking money from Hamas with zero evidence to back it
up.

He later emailed the voter a link to an article on a far-right conspiracy
theory website which simply pointed out that Jamaal had a fundraising
event with pro-peace activist groups, and had no evidence to support his
reckless claim.

This ugly attack by Latimer is part of the larger AIPAC strategy to accuse
anyone in support of innocent Palestinians’ basic human rights of being
tied to Hamas. With 40% of Latimer’s campaign fundraising coming from
AIPAC, it’s no wonder he’s taking a page out of their playbook.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240221-jb.EVY8L6&refcode=em20240221-33440&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=33440%2E1203867%2E1Tz7Fw ]We can’t let Jamaal lose his seat to this out-of-touch, racist, and
Islamophobic candidate who’s bought by AIPAC. Help us defend him in this
June’s primary by splitting a grassroots donation of $3 or
more to Justice Democrats and Jamaal’s campaign now!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240221-jb.EVY8L6&refcode=em20240221-33440&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1021&akid=33440%2E1203867%2E1Tz7Fw ]Contribute $3

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1022&akid=33440%2E1203867%2E1Tz7Fw ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1023&akid=33440%2E1203867%2E1Tz7Fw ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20240221-33440-footer&t=1024&refcode2=33440_1203867_1Tz7Fw&akid=33440%2E1203867%2E1Tz7Fw

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1025&akid=33440%2E1203867%2E1Tz7Fw

Early voting in the Texas primary election started this week, and we are heading into the election in a very strong position. On Friday, the Houston Chronicle endorsed Lizzie for re-election. Here’s a little bit of what the editorial board had to say:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe2402wu?refcode=lpfe2402wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe2402wu?refcode=lpfe2402wu]
“Fletcher ... is a well-liked three-term incumbent who works as hard as any member of the Texas delegation. She stays engaged with her constituents, holding quarterly public meetings and dozens of public events, and says she’s brought $643 million in federal taxpayer dollars back to her district. She has proven she can work across the aisle in an extremely polarized and narrowly divided House of Representatives ... That’s the kind of effective representation we believe Fletcher’s constituents elected her for. We urge Democratic voters to give her another chance to keep her seat in November.”
Voters in the 7th District can start casting their ballots for Lizzie! That includes Lizzie, who cast her ballot with Scott at an early voting location in the district!

**_"I hope Nancy gets the help she needs. I really do... She’s got a lot of challenges." -FORMER Speaker of the House, Kevin McCarthy_**

This aint my first rodeo, Peter.

I’m used to people underestimating me. _Truly!_

I didn’t become the first woman to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets by having a lot of people believe in me.

I didn’t pick myself up after dropping out of high school and go waitress at Waffle House to put food on the table because of handouts.

I didn’t become a strong conservative FIGHTER in Washington DC because I didn’t face challenges.

**_NOPE!_**

I got to where I am because I am a fighter. | **Did you see this, Peter?**
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79460166/456528917/-1109429436?refcode=BLU_EM_SWC_2024-02-21_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODczMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYTIzYjU4Ni1mOGQwLWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1kVkjfwC1UcWFlbtJZzp22lAUtf_N_Tzijo69CV3bYs=)
This latest ruling in Alabama could have devastating consequences for women across the country who experience infertility and rely on reproductive technology like IVF to conceive.

As someone who struggled with fertility issues, this is personal to me. As a mother of two, my children, Clay and Adrienne, mean the world to me, and when I hear how many women across the country struggle to get pregnant (1 in 5), I feel for them.

**That’s why I joined my colleague Senator Tammy Duckworth to introduce legislation to protect the right to access assisted reproductive technologies like IVF.**

Rulings like the one in Alabama are precisely why we need legislation at the federal level. Since _Roe v. Wade_ , more and more states have not only sought to restrict abortion access but also restrict individuals’ access to basic reproductive healthcare, including IVF.

The government has no place in an individual’s reproductive decisions. I will continue fighting for expanded protections for reproductive healthcare, but I need your support to keep me in this fight.

As the presidential election approaches, the Biden administration
is expanding its controversial initiative to control information and
censor Americans by funding a new project that tracks the spread of
“mis-, dis-, and mal-information (MDM)” by internet users. A
public university in South Carolina is getting nearly $1
million from the government to map the spread of MDM in real time and
create an online dashboard with an MDM tracker. The Department of
Justice’s (DOJ) National Institute of Justice (NIJ) is doling out
the funds to researchers at Clemson University to meet its reported
mission of “improving knowledge and understanding of crime and
justice issues through science.” The NIJ claims it provides
objective and independent knowledge and tools to inform the
decision-making of the criminal and juvenile justice communities to
reduce crime and advance justice.

[alt_text] [*****] February 21, 2024 [article-image] [] As the presidential election approaches, the Biden administration is expanding its controversial initiative to control information and censor Americans by funding a new project that tracks the spread of “mis-, dis-, and mal-information (MDM)” by internet users. A public university in South Carolina is getting nearly $1 million from the government to map the spread of MDM in real time and create an online dashboard with an MDM tracker. The Department of Justice’s (DOJ) National Institute of Justice (NIJ) is doling out the funds to researchers at Clemson University to meet its reported mission of “improving knowledge and understanding of crime and justice issues through science.” The NIJ claims it provides objective and independent knowledge and tools to inform the decision-making of the criminal and juvenile justice communities to reduce crime and advance justice. The month of February is recognized as Black History Month – a month to celebrate and uplift generations of Black Americans’ cultural, political, and economic contributions to our nation’s history.

As we take the time to celebrate this invaluable history, we’re also reminded of the work ahead of us to achieve racial justice and equity. I’m proud to have dedicated my career to working toward social justice, championing voting rights legislation, and tackling disparities in housing and education.

Linda

TO: President Biden
FROM: A grateful Democrat
Subject: I’m so grateful.

**Dear President Biden,

I’m so thankful for everything you’ve done as President!

**Despite MAGA turmoil, over the last three years, you’ve fought TIRELESSLY for the American people — defending abortion rights, confirming an incredible Supreme Court Justice, saving Social Security from GOP cuts, and creating millions of jobs for the people.**

I know standing up to MAGA Republican attacks isn’t easy, but it is always the right thing to do.

So as the 2024 race kicks into high gear, I wanted to show my support and thank you for being such an amazing leader for our country!

[**I hope you know that there are MILLIONS of us across the nation who stand with you. That’s why I’m signing this letter and chipping in $3 to the Voter Protection Project to thank you and to keep electing incredible Democrats up and down the ballot »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/62498?t=9&akid=13065%2E878179%2E0XEfQj)** | [SPACE RUNNING OUT: Donate $3 to sign now »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/62498?t=10&akid=13065%2E878179%2E0XEfQj)

Floods, fires, and droughts--California is on the frontlines of climate change. Yet, for decades, career politicians have exacerbated the crisis. They've given sweetheart deals to Big Oil and failed to safeguard us from natural disasters, all while ignoring our crumbling electric grid.
Time is running out, and our state's future is at stake. **California has not always had a fierce environmental champion in the U.S. Senate; we cannot afford to let that be the case ever again.** We need a Senator who has _never_ been beholden to Big Oil to do the work.
I'll always oppose federal subsidies and tax breaks for polluters and will require them to clean up their messes, and I'll bring back California's appropriate share of federal investments to achieve net-zero carbon pollution.
California has done the work on climate, from households adopting environmentally friendly practices, like food waste recycling, to our state setting the most ambitious climate goals in the nation. **Our federal government should reward Californians, who have led the way, rather than directing federal investments into anti-union, polluter-friendly states.**
I've seen firsthand how the **fossil fuel lobby uses its cash to buy votes in Washington, preventing policies that advance the energy of the 21st century, like solar and wind**. That's why I'm not afraid to rewrite the rules to make the federal government work for us--not corporations--and focus on policies that will create a resilient California for generations to come.
My eight-point plan lays out how I'll protect our environment, tackle the climate crisis, and secure California's fair share of federal green investments.
1. **Holding polluters accountable:** I successfully pressured the Biden Administration to update the rules so that Big Oil has to put up money for cleanup, rather than leaving taxpayers on the hook for its messes. In the Senate, I'll fight to make those changes permanent.

2. **Protecting our public lands:** I strongly support efforts to protect 30% of our natural landscapes by 2030, and to make sure these protected lands include communities that currently lack green space.

3. **Fighting for California 's fair share of water:** In the House, I secured money for the expansion of recycled water projects, groundwater storage projects, and the Syphon Reservoir Project, which will expand water storage capacity ten-fold. In the Senate I'll build on this work, allowing us to stretch our water resources and protect fragile environments.

4. **Making California resilient from future climate disasters:** I'll push to make it affordable for working families in high-risk areas to improve the resilience of their homes. We as taxpayers cannot keep paying out hundreds of billions of dollars each decade because Washington has failed to enact climate-mitigation policies.

5. **Investing in clean and renewable energy:** I'll make sure the federal government rewards California for our clean energy investment and harnesses our renewable energy potential. I'll build on the progress of the Inflation Reduction Act by helping low-income Californians afford electric vehicles, extending the electric vehicle tax credit, building more infrastructure that Californians need to charge their electric vehicles, and strengthening credits for wind and solar power development.

6. **Upgrading our national electric grid:** Standing up to polluters, we should advance policies that streamline the approval of clean energy projects that update our electrical grid to be climate resilient and energy efficient.

7. **Fully implement the Inflation Reduction Act:** I know firsthand the frustration of how high costs can make it hard to upgrade to safer, energy-efficient appliances. That is why I've forcefully pushed the Biden Administration to get clean energy rebates and tax credits to California families ASAP.

8. **Decarbonizing our infrastructure:** As our country builds next-generation infrastructure, we must transition to using next-generation construction materials.

Thanks for reading my plan, and thanks for caring about the future we can build for California.
Katie Porter

**Peter- Mark your calendar!**

Saturday, **June 22nd** is the seventh annual Rock the Ride, a benefit ride and walk for gun violence prevention.

Rock the Ride is a dedicated platform that aims to raise funds in support of local and national organizations committed to putting an end to gun violence in our country.

As an avid cycler and advocate for gun violence prevention, Mike is proud to lead the ride and is hoping for the biggest turnout yet.

Mike is a lifelong hunter and gun owner himself, so he knows firsthand how important it is that firearms are used responsibly. That’s why he’s introduced a bipartisan bill to expand background checks and close loopholes that might lead to devastating shootings.

**Polls consistently show that we have the support of younger voters:**
_“Candidate support varies by age group,” Spencer Kimball, executive director of Emerson College Polling, noted. “Schiff’s support is highest among voters in their 60s, at 45%, and those over 70, with 39%, whereas Porter’s strength is among young voters, where she holds 23%. Notably, this group has the highest share of undecided voters at 28%. Garvey’s strength is also with older voters, with 33% support among voters over 70.”_
Derek, I don’t always feel young, especially when my kids call my social media “cringe.” But we’re winning over “younger” voters—people in their 20s, 30s, 40s, and 50s, because younger Californians are often most concerned they won’t be able to afford to live here and raise families here—and they know we have to shake up Washington to actually address the problem. When I visited with students at UC Davis, I asked how many of them thought they could ever afford to buy a home here in California, _and not a single student raised their hand._
**But especially in primaries, younger people vote at lower rates than older voters. And as the polling shows, younger voters who are currently uncommitted to a candidate will be key to our victory. We have to put serious effort into turning out and persuading millennial and Gen Z voters.[With just 13 days to the primary, is there anything you can give to help us reach younger voters?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240221-2?refcode=em20240221-38034&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38034_3422442_e4NMJx&akid=38034%2E3422442%2Ee4NMJx)**

This isn’t just about my race. Young people are losing faith in our democracy and in our party. **As Democrats, we need to show young voters that our government can work for them.** That means having elected officials who are responsive and represent their voters, not special interests. It means having an economy that actually works for working people. And it means successfully communicating when we pass meaningful legislation—it’s my job as an elected official to tell my constituents how I can help—not the other way around!
Anything you can give today will help us reach the young voters who will determine our future.
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240221-2?refcode=em20240221-38034&refcode2=38034_3422442_e4NMJx&akid=38034%2E3422442%2Ee4NMJx)

Katie Porter

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. ---
**_"I hope Nancy gets the help she needs. I really do... She’s got a lot of challenges." -FORMER Speaker of the House, Kevin McCarthy_**

This aint my first rodeo, Peter.

I’m used to people underestimating me. _Truly!_

I didn’t become the first woman to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets by having a lot of people believe in me.

I didn’t pick myself up after dropping out of high school and go waitress at Waffle House to put food on the table because of handouts.

I didn’t become a strong conservative FIGHTER in Washington DC because I didn’t face challenges.

**_NOPE!_**

I got to where I am because I am a fighter. body:
Mackenzie For Congress | | | | |
---
Fellow American,
#TeamMackenzie had another great week! **Today, we found out that my name will appear first on the ballot in the upcoming April 23rd primary.** As the America First candidate, I am happy to be first on the ballot to defeat Susan Wild.
Here is what is included in this Mackenzie Minute:
* **WILD DEMOCRATS MEDDLING IN GOP PRIMARY**
* **MY PROVEN CONSERVATIVE RESULTS**
* **ENDORSEMENT FROM PA’S FUTURE CONSERVATIVE LEADERS**
* **PICTURES AROUND PA-7**

Thank you again to everyone who is working so hard to help us turn PA-7 RED!
All the Best,
-Ryan Mackenzie
|
---
**WILD DEMOCRATS MEDDLING IN GOP PRIMARY**
Speaking of Susan Wild, news reports this week prove that her radical allies are using sleazy tactics to try and take me out. They are using conservative sounding, dark-money super PACs to spread false information – because they know I am the only candidate who can beat Wild in November.
**The FAKE PACs to watch out for are:**
* Integrity Leadership Fund
* PA Congressional Conservatives Fund
* Lehigh Valley Republican Congressional Leadership Fund

**Don’t be fooled. And spread the word so that other Republicans are not fooled either! I am the ONLY Republican with a PROVEN record of getting conservative results - a record I will continue in Congress.**
|
---
**MY PROVEN CONSERVATIVE RESULTS**
If you want to send a proven conservative to Washington - someone who has actually shown they can get results - I am the best candidate.
**Here are five examples of conservative legislation that I authored and was able to get passed into law as a State Representative...**
**Tackling Illegal Immigration**[**Act 75 of 2019**](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=1e0bbc886b&e=5ccada9200)**** Known as the Construction Industry Employee Verification Act, this law protects American workers by requiring employers in the construction industry to use the federal E-Verify system to ensure that illegal immigrants aren’t taking American jobs.
**Combating Local Fraud**[**Act 38 of 2017**](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=7acd137500&e=5ccada9200)**** This law helps protect local taxpayers by putting measures in place to reduce fraud by local tax collectors
**Helping Our Veterans**[**Act 135 of 2016**](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=53f7c0238d&e=5ccada9200)**** The “Pennsylvania Startups for Soldiers” program was created under this law to help make it easier for veterans and active duty service members to start a business, create jobs, and grow our economy.
**Putting Taxpayers First**[**Act 52 of 2013**](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=1b4618166d&e=5ccada9200)**** This legislation closed corporate tax loopholes and eliminated the inheritance tax for small, family-owned businesses, in addition to making numerous other changes that helped improve PA’s business tax climate. It was called “The Most Significant Tax Reform In 20 Years” by the PA CPA Journal.
**Standing Up For Consumers**[**Act 129 of 2016**](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=7f5c101fa9&e=5ccada9200) This law strengthened consumer protections in the banking industry.
|
---
**ENDORSEMENT FROM PA’S FUTURE CONSERVATIVE LEADERS**
This week, the PA High School Republicans joined #TeamMackenzie and endorsed my campaign for Congress. Engaging young voters - our future conservative leaders - is an important part of winning against the Democrats this November and I am proud to have them on my side.
PA High School Republican Chairman Giuseppe Schiano DiCola said “I am excited for the candidates we endorse to win in November. I think these are the people who can win back control of the Pennsylvania Delegation and continue promoting the conservative values that we need in the House of Representatives”
|
---
**PICTURES AROUND PA-7**
Happy to receive the endorsement from Ruckus yesterday for #NationalPetDay
|
---
We have under 9 weeks to get the job done and we need your help!
If you are interested in joining our grassroots team you can sign up here: [https://forms.gle/qTdGfWkhGnUnSNWD7](https://mackenzieforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62252a4538e3fe848298033c5&id=4809a2761f&e=5ccada9200)
|

---

Peter,

After a second attempt to impeach incompetent and traitorous Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas, the House finally succeeded.

But for the second time, my opponent – Democrat Gabe Vasquez – voted NO.

Mayorkas is the first cabinet secretary to be impeached in **nearly 150 years** – _and it’s well deserved_ , **as he has allowed record millions of illegal aliens to openly invade our country.**

But apparently, Vasquez thinks he’s doing a _great_ job...

Vasquez, Biden, and Mayorkas continuing to allow this blatant invasion to occur seems more like something out of the Twilight Zone rather than reality.

**But the drugs, crime, human trafficking, and national security threats that are plaguing Americans in every single state are VERY REAL.**

Gabe Vasquez _**_DOES NOT CARE_**_ about this crisis or about securing the border, [**and defeating him in November will bring us one step closer to securing our country and restoring law & order.**](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=f4ac76d01b974939aa6cee85ff61f338&_e=9F7PujoqYwRInSA7dIwIxz_uudoCPWgvsoTxLtwI_kB_KCuKanCT0savuuhnTabAUIgdFxsa9i-h9_KvXnJYZuCNbTtuYDDZ2txb1r4th2aSEbji2VflGIaZ5omCJbuC43fjD2j7NgUkrxOM1qs9DRE4tEcpq3L74KVpjeEJZEhSWk_9-LmVKHWGi90Tuho2oujueaXBhGssxPf0b0_htZckJZmQvKCRet5uqggS-HD_7y0MRcqCoj8jB1_qKZWlelqbOk8Md3HQd1q5CpNlMD7qSUKoQGaTYQPUg2-TTwPKerkwP1cvYxTUFacK7wJywFRLhBhKzkOD7FftPgxNBT4ihgrVIpZzoDzc-Hxz3-_0Lm_16d5QwprXDuQHUOE1Yd3iZJ0Tte8CSIwSesfHYQ%3D%3D)

Fellow Conservative,

My name is Tim Sheehy, a Republican candidate for the U.S. Senate from Montana. I’m a former U.S. Navy SEAL and a 2008 Naval Academy graduate. Right now, I'm the only person standing in the way of Chuck Schumer and his Senate majority.

If you’re hearing from me for the first time today, here is a quick rundown of who I am, why I’m running, and why **[it’s critical that you join President Trump in endorsing my campaign for the U.S. Senate today.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=16d8b2897ce3430197272488d7c5fa5b&_e=RV0XGB_OPluzgqwpWnJpyS2axsl5V85wvzkD3wp6kqWXDxlVkEiB_Zd7C6QeTurHRHtW2Q51L0EOEa3QFpR3aDGOq4-9nPYf_2XuS97mEsQkhHvccPf1gCeopK0KZs1tZUj1bpalIxzr9Q8tIsdU8UAAv0FjoEoM8Tc1M6cXQto_ZedUp2wFK_07amD45znew1wz3rx1F1J3mA9a96LvGHMQzCMeXb05ePmRFzE7ZbT0QYwv__ZeZ--xBBCzJ9smx0AZv-1NEoWtysCdeHgany64cBDY-1rXsVflhAxT1rbUym48vwlZdTZVKsCsRFfWEaldQoywg4WH16clZja5W6u6Hl8FZlfkdtEAijXwoAsbS6gaqDooN_WwBDMkQCS8LgXf6-GBidh0VxlRmnPqsxSlzychpN-6hmQbuj1tI14vkCHkBYbLMna3YAXL9Pde9mJdINDcZ5pjQJMxu_ZVa3QfG5CQhCUEyRosrXNl-goUkECEtX1qfFe9NNRsKAyOFwF7wuCzx1shZsaaiEiqLg%3D%3D)**

**Unlike Joe Biden** , I understand what it is to serve our country, not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I have been wounded in service of our nation. I’ve lost mentors and friends who willingly made the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free.

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=16d8b2897ce3430197272488d7c5fa5b&_e=RV0XGB_OPluzgqwpWnJpyS2axsl5V85wvzkD3wp6kqWXDxlVkEiB_Zd7C6QeTurHRHtW2Q51L0EOEa3QFpR3aDGOq4-9nPYf_2XuS97mEsQkhHvccPf1gCeopK0KZs1tZUj1bpalIxzr9Q8tIsdU8UAAv0FjoEoM8Tc1M6cXQto_ZedUp2wFK_07amD45znew1wz3rx1F1J3mA9a96LvGHMQzCMeXb05ePmRFzE7ZbT0QYwv__ZeZ--xBBCzJ9smx0AZv-1NEoWtysCdeHgany64cBDY-1rXsVflhAxT1rbUym48vwlZdTZVKsCsRFfWEaldQoywg4WH16clZja5W6u6Hl8FZlfkdtEAijXwoAsbS6gaqDooN_WwBDMkQCS8tqMedzfRAGjMzSct684PymPi17zXXuLG6XMrISwqNjjJALUC4Giv5IfbHav3TQ9fVGYu9KjjnSSH-jPSEPe34y1fetRcAwHCIbf9oQZcwR-pLZUCJ8V0_3sTVto62p3liqm8EkPaPFDrKEo9-FTYvw%3D%3D)
**Like President Trump** , I know our nation's best days are ahead of us. Like President Trump, I am sickened by the damage Democrats have inflicted upon our great Republic every day of Joe Biden’s presidency. | **Here's the deal with early voting: **
1. If you vote early by mail or [drop your ballot off at a secure OC Registrar of Voters ballot box](https://maxforoc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0d5d4fbfb4ace920581f6c90d&id=cd26e85dea&e=86e91e802d), our campaign gets notified that your ballot has been returned.

3. Knowing that YOU voted means we can check you off our list and go after lower-propensity Republicans who haven't returned a ballot yet in the final, critical days.

Whether you vote on Election Day or by mail is _entirely_ up to you ... but voting early is one of the most helpful things you can do to ensure we stay as competitive as possible in the final days.

Hope to see your ballot come through! Thank you,

Team Max
